27: #define D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE   32u

29: #define THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN   (1u << 1)

33:   bool initialized;

43: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache(void)
44: {
45:   uint32_t mhcr;
46: 
47:   /* The custom D13x port does not expose NuttX ARCH_DCACHE hooks, while the
48:    * E907 may inherit an enabled write-back cache from the bootloader.  Use
49:    * the vendor's numeric CSR and raw dcache.call encoding so ordinary GCC
50:    * toolchains still make framebuffer writes visible to the DE DMA master.
51:    */
52: 
53:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
54:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) != 0)
55:     {
56:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
57:       __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0010000b" ::: "memory");
58:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
59:     }
60: }
61: 
62: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(const void *address, size_t row_bytes,
63:                                      size_t stride, size_t row_count)
64: {
65:   uintptr_t row;
66:   uint32_t mhcr;
67:   size_t index;
68: 
69:   if (row_bytes == 0 || row_count == 0)
70:     {
71:       return;
72:     }
73: 
74:   /* A cache-wide clean is bounded by the cache capacity and is faster than
75:    * issuing tens of thousands of per-line operations for a large redraw.
76:    */
77: 
78:   if (row_bytes * row_count >= D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT)
79:     {
80:       d13x_fb_clean_cache();
81:       return;
82:     }
83: 
84:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
85:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) == 0)
86:     {
87:       return;
88:     }
89: 
90:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence" ::: "memory");
91:   row = (uintptr_t)address;
92:   for (index = 0; index < row_count; index++)
93:     {
94:       uintptr_t current = row & ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
95:       uintptr_t end = (row + row_bytes + D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u) &
96:                       ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
97: 
98:       while (current < end)
99:         {
100:           register uintptr_t cache_address __asm__("a0") = current;
101: 
102:           /* T-Head dcache.cpa cleans one physical cache line. */
103: 
104:           __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0295000b" : "+r"(cache_address) ::
105:                                "memory");
106:           current += D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE;
107:         }
108: 
109:       row += stride;
110:     }
111: 
112:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence\n\t"
113:                        "fence.i\n\t"
114:                        ".long 0x01a0000b" ::: "memory");
115: }

158:                               const struct fb_area_s *area)
159: {
160:   uint32_t x;
161:   uint32_t y;
162:   uint32_t width;
163:   uint32_t height;
164:   uintptr_t address;
165: 
166:   (void)vtable;
167: 
168:   if (area == NULL || !g_fb.initialized || area->w == 0 || area->h == 0)
169:     {
170:       return -EINVAL;
171:     }
172: 
173:   x = area->x;
174:   y = area->y;
175:   width = area->w;
176:   height = area->h;
177:   if (x >= D13X_FB_WIDTH || y >= D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
178:     {
179:       return -EINVAL;
180:     }
181: 
182:   if (width > D13X_FB_WIDTH - x)
183:     {
184:       width = D13X_FB_WIDTH - x;
185:     }
186: 
187:   if (height > D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS - y)
188:     {
189:       height = D13X_FB_HEIGHT * D13X_FB_BUFFERS - y;
190:     }
191: 
192:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + y * D13X_FB_STRIDE + x * 2u;
193: 
194:   d13x_fb_clean_cache_area((const void *)address, width * 2u,
195:                            D13X_FB_STRIDE, height);
196:   g_fb.update_area.x = x;
197:   g_fb.update_area.y = y % D13X_FB_HEIGHT;
198:   g_fb.update_area.w = width;
199:   g_fb.update_area.h = height;
200:   g_fb.update_pending = true;
201:   return OK;
202: }
203: #endif

205: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
206:                               struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
207: {
208:   uintptr_t address;
209: 
210:   (void)vtable;
211: 
212:   if (pinfo == NULL || !g_fb.initialized ||
213:       (pinfo->yoffset != 0 && pinfo->yoffset != D13X_FB_HEIGHT))
214:     {
215:       return -EINVAL;
216:     }
217: 
218:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE;
219: 
220:   /* LVGL uses DIRECT double buffering.  Before drawing a new dirty area it
221:    * copies the previous frame's dirty areas into the back buffer so both
222:    * framebuffers remain identical.  FBIO_UPDATE only describes the current
223:    * dirty area and therefore does not cover those synchronization copies.
224:    * Cleaning just that area can leave stale cache lines in the back buffer,
225:    * which appear as old labels and widgets after the subsequent page flip.
226:    *
227:    * Clean the complete (finite) data cache immediately before publishing the
228:    * buffer.  This makes every LVGL write visible to the DE DMA master.  It is
229:    * also cheaper than walking the entire 1.2 MiB framebuffer line by line.
230:    */
231: 
232:   d13x_fb_clean_cache();
233:   d13x_de_set_framebuffer(address);
234:   g_fb.displayed_yoffset = pinfo->yoffset;
235:   return OK;
236: }

238: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
239: static int d13x_fb_waitforvsync(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)
240: {
241:   const struct fb_area_s *area;
242:   uint32_t source_y;
243:   uint32_t dest_y;
244:   uint32_t row;
245:   int ret;
246: 
247:   ret = d13x_de_wait_for_vsync();
248:   if (ret >= 0 && g_fb.update_pending)
249:     {
250:       area = &g_fb.update_area;
251:       source_y = g_fb.displayed_yoffset + area->y;
252:       dest_y = (g_fb.displayed_yoffset == 0 ? D13X_FB_HEIGHT : 0) +
253:                area->y;
254: 
255:       /* Keep both DIRECT framebuffers identical at the frame boundary.
256:        * This makes the next buffer safe even when only a label-sized area
257:        * changed, without paying the cost of a full-screen copy.
258:        */
259: 
260:       for (row = 0; row < area->h; row++)
261:         {
262:           memcpy(g_fb.memory + (dest_y + row) * D13X_FB_STRIDE +
263:                    area->x * 2u,
264:                  g_fb.memory + (source_y + row) * D13X_FB_STRIDE +
265:                    area->x * 2u,
266:                  area->w * 2u);
267:         }
268: 
269:       d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(
270:         g_fb.memory + dest_y * D13X_FB_STRIDE + area->x * 2u,
271:         area->w * 2u, D13X_FB_STRIDE, area->h);
272:       g_fb.update_pending = false;
273:     }
274: 
275:   /* Release the pan entry after the frame boundary.  Also release it on a
276:    * hardware timeout so a missing IRQ cannot permanently stop LVGL refresh.
277:    */
278: 
279:   fb_remove_paninfo(vtable, FB_NO_OVERLAY);
280: 
281:   return ret;
282: }
283: #endif

291: static int d13x_fb_setpower(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int power)

295:   if (!g_fb.initialized)

17: #define BIT(n)                    (1u << (n))
18: 
19: #define DE_CONFIG_UPDATE          0x008u
20: #define VIDEO_LAYER_CTRL          0x020u
21: #define UI_LAYER_CTRL             0x0a0u
22: #define UI_LAYER_SIZE             0x0a4u
23: #define UI_LAYER_RECT_CTRL        0x0b0u
24: #define UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE        0x0c0u
25: #define UI_RECT_OFFSET            0x0c4u
26: #define UI_RECT_STRIDE            0x0c8u
27: #define UI_RECT_ADDR              0x0ccu
28: #define BLENDING_BG_COLOR         0x100u
29: #define BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE      0x104u
30: #define UI_LAYER_OFFSET           0x10cu
31: #define WB_CTRL                   0x170u
32: #define TIMING_CTRL               0x1d0u
33: #define TIMING_INIT               0x1d4u
34: #define TIMING_STATUS             0x1d8u
35: #define TIMING_LINE_SET           0x1dcu
36: #define TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE        0x1e0u
37: #define TIMING_H_PORCH            0x1e4u
38: #define TIMING_V_PORCH            0x1e8u
39: #define TIMING_SYNC_PULSE         0x1ecu
40: #define TIMING_POLARITY           0x1f0u
41: #define QOS_UI                    0x88cu
42: #define QOS_URGENT                0x890u
43: 
44: #define UI_FORMAT_RGB565          0x0eu
45: #define UI_LAYER_ENABLE           BIT(0)
46: #define UI_ALPHA_ENABLE           BIT(2)
47: #define TIMING_ENABLE             BIT(0)
48: #define DE_SOFT_RESET_ENABLE      BIT(16)
49: 
50: #define CMU_CLK_DE                (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x08c0u)
51: #define MOD_RESET_DEASSERT        BIT(13)
52: #define MOD_BUS_ENABLE            BIT(12)
53: #define MOD_CLOCK_ENABLE          BIT(8)
54: #define TIMING_V_BLANK_IRQ        BIT(0)

56: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
57: static sem_t g_de_vsync_sem;
58: static bool g_de_vsync_initialized;
59: static volatile bool g_de_vsync_waiting;
60: 
61: static int d13x_de_interrupt(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
62: {
63:   uint32_t status;
64: 
65:   (void)irq;
66:   (void)context;
67:   (void)arg;
68: 
69:   status = getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + TIMING_STATUS);
70:   putreg32(status, D13X_DE_BASE + TIMING_STATUS);
71:   if ((status & TIMING_V_BLANK_IRQ) != 0 && g_de_vsync_waiting)
72:     {
73:       g_de_vsync_waiting = false;
74:       nxsem_post(&g_de_vsync_sem);
75:     }
76: 
77:   return OK;
78: }
79: #endif

81: static inline void de_write(uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
82: {
83:   putreg32(value, D13X_DE_BASE + offset);
84: }

86: static inline uint32_t de_size(uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
87: {
88:   return ((height & 0x1fffu) << 16) | (width & 0x1fffu);
89: }

91: int d13x_de_initialize(uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
92:                        uint32_t hfp, uint32_t hbp, uint32_t hsync,
93:                        uint32_t vfp, uint32_t vbp, uint32_t vsync,
94:                        uint32_t stride)
95: {
96:   uint32_t reg;
97: 
98:   if (width == 0 || height == 0 || width > 0x1fff || height > 0x1fff ||
99:       stride > 0x7fff)
100:     {
101:       return -EINVAL;
102:     }
103: 
104:   /* D13x DE v1.1 runs at 150 MHz from PLL_INT1 / 8. */
105: 
106:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_DE);
107:   reg &= ~0x3fu;
108:   reg |= 7u | MOD_RESET_DEASSERT | MOD_BUS_ENABLE | MOD_CLOCK_ENABLE;
109:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_DE);
110: 
111:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, 0);
112:   de_write(VIDEO_LAYER_CTRL, 0);
113:   de_write(UI_LAYER_CTRL, 0);
114:   de_write(UI_LAYER_RECT_CTRL, 0);
115:   de_write(TIMING_INIT, 0);
116:   de_write(TIMING_STATUS, 0xffffffffu);
117: 
118: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
119:   if (!g_de_vsync_initialized)
120:     {
121:       nxsem_init(&g_de_vsync_sem, 0, 0);
122:       if (irq_attach(D13X_IRQ_DE, d13x_de_interrupt, NULL) < 0)
123:         {
124:           nxsem_destroy(&g_de_vsync_sem);
125:           return -EIO;
126:         }
127: 
128:       g_de_vsync_initialized = true;
129:     }
130: #endif
131: 
132:   de_write(TIMING_ACTIVE_SIZE, de_size(width, height));
133:   de_write(TIMING_H_PORCH, ((hbp & 0x1fffu) << 16) |
134:                             (hfp & 0x1fffu));
135:   de_write(TIMING_V_PORCH, ((vbp & 0x1fffu) << 16) |
136:                             (vfp & 0x1fffu));
137:   de_write(TIMING_SYNC_PULSE, ((vsync & 0x7ffu) << 16) |
138:                                (hsync & 0x7ffu));
139:   de_write(TIMING_POLARITY, 0);
140:   de_write(TIMING_LINE_SET, 2u << 16);
141: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
142:   de_write(TIMING_INIT, TIMING_V_BLANK_IRQ);
143: #else
144:   de_write(TIMING_INIT, 0);
145: #endif
146: 
147:   de_write(BLENDING_BG_COLOR, 0);
148:   de_write(BLENDING_OUTPUT_SIZE, de_size(width, height));
149:   de_write(UI_LAYER_SIZE, de_size(width, height));
150:   de_write(UI_LAYER_OFFSET, 0);
151:   de_write(UI_RECT_INPUT_SIZE, de_size(width, height));
152:   de_write(UI_RECT_OFFSET, 0);
153:   de_write(UI_RECT_STRIDE, stride);
154: 
155:   reg = (0xffu << 24) | (UI_FORMAT_RGB565 << 8) |
156:         UI_ALPHA_ENABLE | UI_LAYER_ENABLE;
157:   de_write(UI_LAYER_CTRL, reg);
158:   de_write(UI_LAYER_RECT_CTRL, BIT(0));
159: 
160:   reg = getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + WB_CTRL);
161:   de_write(WB_CTRL, reg | DE_SOFT_RESET_ENABLE);
162: 
163:   de_write(QOS_UI, (0xdu << 28) | (0x60u << 16) |
164:                    (0xdu << 12) | 0x40u);
165:   de_write(QOS_URGENT, BIT(15) | BIT(14) | 0x40u);
166:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, BIT(0));
167: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
168:   up_enable_irq(D13X_IRQ_DE);
169: #endif
170:   return OK;
171: }
172: 
173: void d13x_de_set_framebuffer(uintptr_t address)
174: {
175:   de_write(UI_RECT_ADDR, (uint32_t)address);
176:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, BIT(0));
177: }
178: 
179: void d13x_de_enable(void)
180: {
181:   uint32_t reg = getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + TIMING_CTRL);
182:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, reg | TIMING_ENABLE);
183:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, BIT(0));
184: }
185: 
186: void d13x_de_disable(void)
187: {
188:   uint32_t reg = getreg32(D13X_DE_BASE + TIMING_CTRL);
189:   de_write(TIMING_CTRL, reg & ~TIMING_ENABLE);
190:   de_write(DE_CONFIG_UPDATE, BIT(0));
191: }
192:

194: int d13x_de_wait_for_vsync(void)
195: {
196:   irqstate_t flags;
197:   int ret;
198: 
199:   if (!g_de_vsync_initialized)
200:     {
201:       return -ENODEV;
202:     }
203: 
204:   flags = enter_critical_section();
205:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_de_vsync_sem) == OK)
206:     {
207:     }
208: 
209:   g_de_vsync_waiting = true;
210:   leave_critical_section(flags);
211: 
212:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_de_vsync_sem,
213:                                        MSEC2TICK(100));
214:   if (ret < 0)
215:     {
216:       flags = enter_critical_section();
217:       g_de_vsync_waiting = false;
218:       leave_critical_section(flags);
219:     }
220: 
221:   return ret;
222: }
223: 
224: void d13x_de_uninitialize_vsync(void)
225: {
226:   if (g_de_vsync_initialized)
227:     {
228:       up_disable_irq(D13X_IRQ_DE);
229:       irq_detach(D13X_IRQ_DE);
230:       nxsem_destroy(&g_de_vsync_sem);
231:       g_de_vsync_initialized = false;
232:       g_de_vsync_waiting = false;
233:     }

93: int lv_nuttx_fbdev_set_file(lv_display_t * disp, const char * file)
94: {
95:     int ret;
96:     LV_ASSERT(disp && file);
97:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
98: 
99:     if(dsc->fd >= 0) close(dsc->fd);
100: 
101:     /* Open the file for reading and writing*/
102: 
103:     dsc->fd = open(file, O_RDWR);
104:     if(dsc->fd < 0) {
105:         LV_LOG_ERROR("Error: cannot open framebuffer device");
106:         return -errno;
107:     }
108:     LV_LOG_USER("The framebuffer device was opened successfully");
109: 
110:     if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&dsc->vinfo)) < 0) {
111:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO) failed: %d", errno);
112:         ret = -errno;
113:         goto errout;
114:     }
115: 
116:     LV_LOG_USER("VideoInfo:");
117:     LV_LOG_USER("      fmt: %u", dsc->vinfo.fmt);
118:     LV_LOG_USER("     xres: %u", dsc->vinfo.xres);
119:     LV_LOG_USER("     yres: %u", dsc->vinfo.yres);
120:     LV_LOG_USER("  nplanes: %u", dsc->vinfo.nplanes);
121: 
122:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &dsc->pinfo)) < 0) {
123:         goto errout;
124:     }
125: 
126:     lv_color_format_t color_format = fb_fmt_to_color_format(dsc->vinfo.fmt);
127:     if(color_format == LV_COLOR_FORMAT_UNKNOWN) {
128:         goto errout;
129:     }
130: 
131:     dsc->mem = mmap(NULL, dsc->pinfo.fblen, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
132:                     MAP_SHARED | MAP_FILE, dsc->fd, 0);
133:     if(dsc->mem == MAP_FAILED) {
134:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOGET_PLANEINFO) failed: %d", errno);
135:         ret = -errno;
136:         goto errout;
137:     }
138: 
139:     uint32_t w = dsc->vinfo.xres;
140:     uint32_t h = dsc->vinfo.yres;
141:     uint32_t stride = dsc->pinfo.stride;
142:     uint32_t data_size = h * stride;
143:     lv_draw_buf_init(&dsc->buf1, w, h, color_format, stride, dsc->mem, data_size);
144: 
145:     /* Check buffer mode */
146:     bool double_buffer = dsc->pinfo.yres_virtual == (dsc->vinfo.yres * 2);
147:     if(double_buffer) {
148:         if((ret = fbdev_init_mem2(dsc)) < 0) {
149:             goto errout;
150:         }
151: 
152:         lv_draw_buf_init(&dsc->buf2, w, h, color_format, stride, dsc->mem2, data_size);
153:         lv_display_set_draw_buffers(disp, &dsc->buf1, &dsc->buf2);
154:     }
155:     else {
156:         dsc->mem_off_screen = malloc(data_size);
157:         LV_ASSERT_MALLOC(dsc->mem_off_screen);
158:         if(!dsc->mem_off_screen) {
159:             ret = -ENOMEM;
160:             LV_LOG_ERROR("Failed to allocate memory for off-screen buffer");
161:             goto errout;
162:         }
163: 
164:         LV_LOG_USER("Use off-screen mode, memory: %p, size: %" LV_PRIu32, dsc->mem_off_screen, data_size);
165:         lv_draw_buf_init(&dsc->buf2, w, h, color_format, stride, dsc->mem_off_screen, data_size);
166:         lv_display_set_draw_buffers(disp, &dsc->buf2, NULL);
167:     }
168: 
169:     lv_display_set_color_format(disp, color_format);
170:     lv_display_set_render_mode(disp, LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT);
171:     lv_display_set_resolution(disp, dsc->vinfo.xres, dsc->vinfo.yres);
172:     lv_timer_set_cb(disp->refr_timer, display_refr_timer_cb);
173: 
174:     LV_LOG_USER("Resolution is set to %dx%d at %" LV_PRId32 "dpi",
175:                 dsc->vinfo.xres, dsc->vinfo.yres, lv_display_get_dpi(disp));
176:     return 0;
177: 
178: errout:
179:     close(dsc->fd);
180:     dsc->fd = -1;
181:     return ret;

189: static void fbdev_join_inv_areas(lv_display_t * disp, lv_area_t * final_inv_area)
190: {
191:     uint16_t inv_index;
192: 
193:     bool area_joined = false;
194: 
195:     for(inv_index = 0; inv_index < disp->inv_p; inv_index++) {
196:         if(disp->inv_area_joined[inv_index] == 0) {
197:             const lv_area_t * area_p = &disp->inv_areas[inv_index];
198: 
199:             /* Join to final_area */
200: 
201:             if(!area_joined) {
202:                 /* copy first area */
203:                 lv_area_copy(final_inv_area, area_p);
204:                 area_joined = true;
205:             }
206:             else {
207:                 lv_area_join(final_inv_area,
208:                              final_inv_area,
209:                              area_p);
210:             }
211:         }
212:     }
213: }

216: static void display_refr_timer_cb(lv_timer_t * tmr)
217: {
218:     lv_display_t * disp = lv_timer_get_user_data(tmr);
219:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
220:     struct pollfd pfds[1];
221: 
222:     lv_memzero(pfds, sizeof(pfds));
223:     pfds[0].fd = dsc->fd;
224:     pfds[0].events = POLLOUT;
225: 
226:     /* Query free fb to draw */
227: 
228:     if(poll(pfds, 1, 0) < 0) {
229:         return;
230:     }
231: 
232:     if(pfds[0].revents & POLLOUT) {
233:         lv_display_refr_timer(tmr);

237: static void flush_cb(lv_display_t * disp, const lv_area_t * area, uint8_t * color_p)
238: {
239:     LV_UNUSED(color_p);
240:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
241: 
242:     if(dsc->mem_off_screen) {
243:         /* When rendering in off-screen mode, copy the drawing buffer to fb */
244:         /* buf2(off-screen buffer) -> buf1(fbmem)*/
245:         lv_draw_buf_copy(&dsc->buf1, area, &dsc->buf2, area);
246:     }
247: 
248:     /* Skip the non-last flush */
249: 
250:     if(!lv_display_flush_is_last(disp)) {
251:         lv_display_flush_ready(disp);
252:         return;
253:     }
254: 
255: #if defined(CONFIG_FB_UPDATE)
256:     /*May be some direct update command is required*/
257:     int yoffset = disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1 ?
258:                   0 : dsc->mem2_yoffset;
259: 
260:     /* Join the areas to update */
261:     lv_area_t final_inv_area;
262:     lv_memzero(&final_inv_area, sizeof(final_inv_area));
263:     fbdev_join_inv_areas(disp, &final_inv_area);
264: 
265:     struct fb_area_s fb_area;
266:     fb_area.x = final_inv_area.x1;
267:     fb_area.y = final_inv_area.y1 + yoffset;
268:     fb_area.w = lv_area_get_width(&final_inv_area);
269:     fb_area.h = lv_area_get_height(&final_inv_area);
270:     if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIO_UPDATE, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&fb_area)) < 0) {
271:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIO_UPDATE) failed: %d", errno);
272:     }
273: #endif
274: 
275:     /* double framebuffer */
276: 
277:     if(dsc->mem2 != NULL) {
278:         if(disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1) {
279:             dsc->pinfo.yoffset = 0;
280:         }
281:         else {
282:             dsc->pinfo.yoffset = dsc->mem2_yoffset;
283:         }
284: 
285:         if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIOPAN_DISPLAY, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t) & (dsc->pinfo))) < 0) {
286:             LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOPAN_DISPLAY) failed: %d", errno);
287:         }
288: #if defined(CONFIG_FB_SYNC)
289:         if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIO_WAITFORVSYNC, 0) < 0) {
290:             LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIO_WAITFORVSYNC) failed: %d", errno);
291:         }
292: #endif
293:     }
294:     lv_display_flush_ready(disp);
295: }

297: static lv_color_format_t fb_fmt_to_color_format(int fmt)
298: {
299:     switch(fmt) {
300:         case FB_FMT_RGB16_565:
301:             return LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB565;
302:         case FB_FMT_RGB24:
303:             return LV_COLOR_FORMAT_RGB888;
304:         case FB_FMT_RGB32:
305:             return LV_COLOR_FORMAT_XRGB8888;
306:         case FB_FMT_RGBA32:
307:             return LV_COLOR_FORMAT_ARGB8888;
308:         default:
309:             break;
310:     }
311: 
312:     LV_LOG_ERROR("Unsupported color format: %d", fmt);
313: 
314:     return LV_COLOR_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;

317: static int fbdev_get_pinfo(int fd, FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s * pinfo)
318: {
319:     if(ioctl(fd, FBIOGET_PLANEINFO, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)pinfo)) < 0) {
320:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ERROR: ioctl(FBIOGET_PLANEINFO) failed: %d", errno);
321:         return -errno;
322:     }
323: 
324:     LV_LOG_USER("PlaneInfo (plane %d):", pinfo->display);
325:     LV_LOG_USER("    mem: %p", pinfo->fbmem);
326:     LV_LOG_USER("    fblen: %zu", pinfo->fblen);
327:     LV_LOG_USER("   stride: %u", pinfo->stride);
328:     LV_LOG_USER("  display: %u", pinfo->display);
329:     LV_LOG_USER("      bpp: %u", pinfo->bpp);
330: 
331:     return 0;
332: }

334: static int fbdev_init_mem2(lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc)
335: {
336:     uintptr_t buf_offset;
337:     struct fb_planeinfo_s pinfo;
338:     int ret;
339: 
340:     lv_memzero(&pinfo, sizeof(pinfo));
341: 
342:     /* Get display[1] planeinfo */
343: 
344:     pinfo.display = dsc->pinfo.display + 1;
345: 
346:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &pinfo)) < 0) {
347:         return ret;
348:     }
349: 
350:     /* Check bpp */
351: 
352:     if(pinfo.bpp != dsc->pinfo.bpp) {
353:         LV_LOG_WARN("mem2 is incorrect");
354:         return -EINVAL;
355:     }
356: 
357:     /* Check the buffer address offset,
358:      * It needs to be divisible by pinfo.stride
359:      */
360: 
361:     buf_offset = pinfo.fbmem - dsc->mem;
362: 
363:     if((buf_offset % dsc->pinfo.stride) != 0) {
364:         LV_LOG_WARN("It is detected that buf_offset(%" PRIuPTR ") "
365:                     "and stride(%d) are not divisible, please ensure "
366:                     "that the driver handles the address offset by itself.",
367:                     buf_offset, dsc->pinfo.stride);
368:     }
369: 
370:     /* Calculate the address and yoffset of mem2 */
371: 
372:     if(buf_offset == 0) {
373:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = dsc->vinfo.yres;
374:         dsc->mem2 = pinfo.fbmem + dsc->mem2_yoffset * pinfo.stride;
375:         LV_LOG_USER("Use consecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32,
376:                     dsc->mem2, dsc->mem2_yoffset);
377:     }
378:     else {
379:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = buf_offset / dsc->pinfo.stride;
380:         dsc->mem2 = pinfo.fbmem;
381:         LV_LOG_USER("Use non-consecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32,
382:                     dsc->mem2, dsc->mem2_yoffset);
383:     }
384: 
385:     return 0;
386: }

388: static void display_release_cb(lv_event_t * e)
389: {
390:     lv_display_t * disp = (lv_display_t *) lv_event_get_user_data(e);
391:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
392:     if(dsc) {
393:         lv_display_set_driver_data(disp, NULL);
394:         lv_display_set_flush_cb(disp, NULL);
395: 
396:         if(dsc->fd >= 0) {
397:             close(dsc->fd);
398:             dsc->fd = -1;
399:         }
400: 
401:         if(dsc->mem_off_screen) {
402:             /* Free the off-screen buffer */
403:             free(dsc->mem_off_screen);
404:             dsc->mem_off_screen = NULL;
405:         }
406: 
407:         lv_free(dsc);
408:     }
409:     LV_LOG_USER("Done");
410: }

98:   FAR struct fb_paninfo_s *paninfo; /* Pan info array */
99:   size_t paninfo_count;             /* Pan info count */
100:   spinlock_t lock;                  /* Lock for this framebuffer */
101: };

106:   size_t fblen;                   /* Size of the framebuffer */

179:                                            int overlay)
180: {

188: /****************************************************************************
189:  * Name: fb_add_paninfo
190:  ****************************************************************************/
191: 
192: static int fb_add_paninfo(FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb,
193:                           FAR const union fb_paninfo_u *info,
194:                           int overlay)
195: {
196:   FAR struct circbuf_s *panbuf;
197:   irqstate_t flags;
198:   ssize_t ret;
199: 
200:   DEBUGASSERT(fb != NULL);
201: 
202:   panbuf = fb_get_panbuf(fb, overlay);
203:   if (panbuf == NULL)
204:     {
205:       return -EINVAL;
206:     }
207: 
208:   /* Disable the interrupt when writing to the queue to
209:    * prevent it from being modified by the interrupted
210:    * thread during the writing process.
211:    */
212: 
213:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&fb->lock);
214: 
215:   /* Write planeinfo information to the queue. */
216: 
217:   ret = circbuf_write(panbuf, info, sizeof(union fb_paninfo_u));
218: 
219:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&fb->lock, flags);
220:   if (ret != sizeof(union fb_paninfo_u))
221:     {
222:       gwarn("WARNING: circbuf_write(panbuf) failed\n");
223:     }
224: 
225:   return ret <= 0 ? -ENOSPC : OK;
226: }

261: /****************************************************************************
262:  * Name: fb_open
263:  ****************************************************************************/
264: 
265: static int fb_open(FAR struct file *filep)
266: {
267:   FAR struct inode *inode;
268:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
269:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
270:   irqstate_t flags;
271:   int ret;
272: 
273:   inode = filep->f_inode;
274:   fb    = inode->i_private;
275: 
276:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL);
277: 
278:   priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(*priv));
279:   if (priv == NULL)
280:     {
281:       return -ENOMEM;
282:     }
283: 
284:   priv->overlay = FB_NO_OVERLAY;
285: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
286:   nxsem_init(&priv->wait, 0, 0);
287: #endif
288: 
289:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&fb->lock);
290: 
291:   if (fb->head == NULL)
292:     {
293:       if (fb->vtable->open != NULL &&
294:           (ret = fb->vtable->open(fb->vtable)) < 0)
295:         {
296:           goto err_fb;
297:         }
298:     }
299: 
300:   /* Attach the open structure to the device */
301: 
302:   priv->flink = fb->head;
303:   fb->head = priv;
304:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&fb->lock, flags);
305:   filep->f_priv = priv;
306: 
307:   return 0;
308: 
309: err_fb:
310:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&fb->lock, flags);
311: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
312:   nxsem_destroy(&priv->wait);
313: #endif
314:   kmm_free(priv);
315:   return ret;
316: }

318: /****************************************************************************
319:  * Name: fb_close
320:  ****************************************************************************/
321: 
322: static int fb_close(FAR struct file *filep)
323: {
324:   FAR struct inode *inode;
325:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
326:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
327:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *curr;
328:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *prev;
329:   irqstate_t flags;
330:   int ret;
331: 
332:   inode = filep->f_inode;
333:   fb    = inode->i_private;
334:   priv  = filep->f_priv;
335: 
336:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL && priv != NULL);
337: 
338:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave(&fb->lock);
339: 
340:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->head);
341:   if (fb->head->flink == NULL)
342:     {
343:       if (fb->vtable->close != NULL)
344:         {
345:           ret = fb->vtable->close(fb->vtable);
346:           if (ret < 0)
347:             {
348:               spin_unlock_irqrestore(&fb->lock, flags);
349:               return ret;
350:             }
351:         }
352:     }
353: 
354:   /* Find the open structure in the list of
355:    * open structures for the device.
356:    */
357: 
358:   for (prev = NULL, curr = fb->head;
359:         curr && curr != priv;
360:         prev = curr, curr = curr->flink);
361: 
362:   DEBUGASSERT(curr);
363: 
364:   /* Remove the structure from the device */
365: 
366:   if (prev)
367:     {
368:       prev->flink = priv->flink;
369:     }
370:   else
371:     {
372:       fb->head = priv->flink;
373:     }
374: 
375:   spin_unlock_irqrestore(&fb->lock, flags);
376: 
377: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
378:   nxsem_destroy(&priv->wait);
379: #endif
380:   kmm_free(priv);
381: 
382:   return OK;
383: }

385: /****************************************************************************
386:  * Name: fb_read
387:  ****************************************************************************/
388: 
389: static ssize_t fb_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer, size_t len)
390: {
391:   FAR struct inode *inode;
392:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
393:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
394:   struct fb_panelinfo_s panelinfo;
395:   size_t start;
396:   size_t end;
397:   size_t size;
398:   int ret;
399: 
400:   ginfo("len: %u\n", (unsigned int)len);
401: 
402:   /* Get the framebuffer instance */
403: 
404:   inode = filep->f_inode;
405:   fb    = inode->i_private;
406:   priv  = filep->f_priv;
407: 
408:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL && priv != NULL);
409: 
410:   /* Get panel info */
411: 
412:   ret = fb_get_panelinfo(fb, &panelinfo, priv->overlay);
413: 
414:   if (ret < 0)
415:     {
416:       return ret;
417:     }
418: 
419:   /* Get the start and size of the transfer */
420: 
421:   start = filep->f_pos;
422:   if (start >= panelinfo.fblen)
423:     {
424:       return 0;  /* Return end-of-file */
425:     }
426: 
427:   end = start + len;
428:   if (end >= panelinfo.fblen)
429:     {
430:       end = panelinfo.fblen;
431:     }
432: 
433:   size = end - start;
434: 
435:   /* And transfer the data from the frame buffer */
436: 
437:   memcpy(buffer, panelinfo.fbmem + start, size);
438:   filep->f_pos += size;
439:   return size;
440: }
441: 
442: /****************************************************************************
443:  * Name: fb_write
444:  ****************************************************************************/
445: 
446: static ssize_t fb_write(FAR struct file *filep, FAR const char *buffer,
447:                         size_t len)
448: {
449:   FAR struct inode *inode;
450:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
451:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
452:   struct fb_panelinfo_s panelinfo;
453:   size_t start;
454:   size_t end;
455:   size_t size;
456:   int ret;
457: 
458:   ginfo("len: %u\n", (unsigned int)len);
459: 
460:   /* Get the framebuffer instance */
461: 
462:   inode = filep->f_inode;
463:   fb    = inode->i_private;
464:   priv  = filep->f_priv;
465: 
466:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL && priv != NULL);
467: 
468:   /* Get panel info */
469: 
470:   ret = fb_get_panelinfo(fb, &panelinfo, priv->overlay);
471: 
472:   if (ret < 0)
473:     {
474:       return ret;
475:     }
476: 
477:   /* Get the start and size of the transfer */
478: 
479:   start = filep->f_pos;
480:   if (start >= panelinfo.fblen)
481:     {
482:       return -EFBIG;  /* Cannot extend the framebuffer */
483:     }
484: 
485:   end = start + len;
486:   if (end >= panelinfo.fblen)
487:     {
488:       end = panelinfo.fblen;
489:     }
490: 
491:   size = end - start;
492: 
493:   /* And transfer the data into the frame buffer */
494: 
495:   memcpy(panelinfo.fbmem + start, buffer, size);
496:   filep->f_pos += size;
497:   return size;
498: }

500: /****************************************************************************
501:  * Name: fb_seek
502:  *
503:  * Description:
504:  *   Seek the logical file pointer to the specified position.  The offset
505:  *   is in units of pixels, with offset zero being the beginning of the
506:  *   framebuffer.
507:  *
508:  ****************************************************************************/
509: 
510: static off_t fb_seek(FAR struct file *filep, off_t offset, int whence)
511: {
512:   FAR struct inode *inode;
513:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
514:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
515:   struct fb_panelinfo_s panelinfo;
516:   off_t newpos;
517:   int ret;
518: 
519:   ginfo("offset: %u whence: %d\n", (unsigned int)offset, whence);
520: 
521:   /* Get the framebuffer instance */
522: 
523:   inode = filep->f_inode;
524:   fb    = inode->i_private;
525:   priv  = filep->f_priv;
526: 
527:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL && priv != NULL);
528: 
529:   /* Determine the new, requested file position */
530: 
531:   switch (whence)
532:     {
533:     case SEEK_CUR:
534:       newpos = filep->f_pos + offset;
535:       break;
536: 
537:     case SEEK_SET:
538:       newpos = offset;
539:       break;
540: 
541:     case SEEK_END:
542: 
543:       /* Get panel info */
544: 
545:       ret = fb_get_panelinfo(fb, &panelinfo, priv->overlay);
546: 
547:       if (ret < 0)
548:         {
549:           return ret;
550:         }
551: 
552:       newpos = panelinfo.fblen + offset;
553:       break;
554: 
555:     default:
556: 
557:       /* Return EINVAL if the whence argument is invalid */
558: 
559:       return -EINVAL;
560:     }
561: 
562:   /* Opengroup.org:
563:    *
564:    *  "The lseek() function shall allow the file offset to be set beyond the
565:    *   end of the existing data in the file. If data is later written at this
566:    *   point, subsequent reads of data in the gap shall return bytes with the
567:    *   value 0 until data is actually written into the gap."
568:    *
569:    * We can conform to the first part, but not the second.  Return EINVAL if
570:    *  "...the resulting file offset would be negative for a regular file,
571:    *   block special file, or directory."
572:    */
573: 
574:   if (newpos >= 0)
575:     {
576:       filep->f_pos = newpos;
577:       ret = newpos;
578:     }
579:   else
580:     {
581:       ret = -EINVAL;
582:     }
583: 
584:   return ret;
585: }

587: /****************************************************************************
588:  * Name: fb_ioctl
589:  *
590:  * Description:
591:  *   The standard ioctl method.
592:  *
593:  ****************************************************************************/

595: static int fb_ioctl(FAR struct file *filep, int cmd, unsigned long arg)
596: {
597:   FAR struct inode *inode;
598:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
599:   int ret = OK;
600: 
601:   ginfo("cmd: %d arg: %ld\n", cmd, arg);

603:   /* Get the framebuffer instance */
604: 
605:   inode = filep->f_inode;
606:   fb    = inode->i_private;
607: 
608:   /* Process the IOCTL command */
609: 
610:   switch (cmd)
611:     {
612:       case FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO:  /* Get color plane info */
613:         {
614:           FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo =
615:             (FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
616: 
617:           DEBUGASSERT(vinfo != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);
618:           if (fb->vtable->getvideoinfo == NULL)
619:             {
620:               ret = -ENOTTY;
621:               break;
622:             }
623: 
624:           ret = fb->vtable->getvideoinfo(fb->vtable, vinfo);
625:         }
626:         break;
627: 
628:       case FBIOGET_PLANEINFO:  /* Get video plane info */
629:         {
630:           FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo =
631:             (FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
632: 
633:           DEBUGASSERT(pinfo != NULL);
634:           ret = fb_get_planeinfo(fb, pinfo, pinfo->display);
635:         }
636:         break;
637: 
638: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_CMAP
639:       case FBIOGET_CMAP:       /* Get RGB color mapping */
640:         {
641:           FAR struct fb_cmap_s *cmap =
642:             (FAR struct fb_cmap_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
643: 
644:           DEBUGASSERT(cmap != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);
645:           if (fb->vtable->getcmap == NULL)
646:             {
647:               ret = -ENOTTY;
648:               break;
649:             }
650: 
651:           ret = fb->vtable->getcmap(fb->vtable, cmap);
652:         }
653:         break;
654: 
655:       case FBIOPUT_CMAP:       /* Put RGB color mapping */
656:         {
657:           FAR const struct fb_cmap_s *cmap =
658:             (FAR struct fb_cmap_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
659: 
660:           DEBUGASSERT(cmap != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);
661:           if (fb->vtable->putcmap == NULL)
662:             {
663:               ret = -ENOTTY;
664:               break;
665:             }
666: 
667:           ret = fb->vtable->putcmap(fb->vtable, cmap);
668:         }
669:         break;
670: #endif
671: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR
672:       case FBIOGET_CURSOR:     /* Get cursor attributes */
673:         {
674:           FAR struct fb_cursorattrib_s *attrib =
675:             (FAR struct fb_cursorattrib_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
676: 
677:           DEBUGASSERT(attrib != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);
678:           if (fb->vtable->getcursor == NULL)
679:             {
680:               ret = -ENOTTY;
681:             }
682: 
683:           ret = fb->vtable->getcursor(fb->vtable, attrib);
684:         }
685:         break;
686: 
687:       case FBIOPUT_CURSOR:     /* Set cursor attributes */
688:         {
689:           FAR struct fb_setcursor_s *cursor =
690:             (FAR struct fb_setcursor_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
691: 
692:           DEBUGASSERT(cursor != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);
693:           if (fb->vtable->setcursor == NULL)
694:             {
695:               ret = -ENOTTY;
696:               break;
697:             }
698: 
699:           ret = fb->vtable->setcursor(fb->vtable, cursor);
700:         }
701:         break;
702: #endif
703: 
704: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
705:       case FBIO_UPDATE:  /* Update the modified framebuffer data  */
706:         {
707:           struct fb_area_s *area = (FAR struct fb_area_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
708: 
709:           DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL);
710:           if (fb->vtable->updatearea == NULL)
711:             {
712:               ret = -ENOTTY;
713:               break;
714:             }
715: 
716:           ret = fb->vtable->updatearea(fb->vtable, area);
717:         }
718:         break;
719: #endif

721: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
722:       case FBIO_WAITFORVSYNC:  /* Wait upon vertical sync */
723:         {
724:           FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv = (FAR struct fb_priv_s *)filep->f_priv;
725: 
726:           DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL);

731:             }

748:               break;

795:         break;

799:           FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo =
800:             (FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);

802:           DEBUGASSERT(oinfo != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);

804:             {
805:               ret = -ENOTTY;
806:               break;
807:             }
808: 
809:           ret = fb->vtable->setchromakey(fb->vtable, oinfo);
810:         }
811:         break;
812: 
813:       case FBIOSET_COLOR:  /* Set video overlay color */
814:         {
815:           FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo =
816:             (FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);
817: 
818:           DEBUGASSERT(oinfo != NULL && fb->vtable != NULL);
819:           if (fb->vtable->setcolor == NULL)
820:             {
821:               ret = -ENOTTY;
822:               break;
823:             }
824: 
825:           ret = fb->vtable->setcolor(fb->vtable, oinfo);
826:         }
827:         break;
828: 
829:       case FBIOSET_BLANK:  /* Blank or unblank video overlay */
830:         {
831:           FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *oinfo =
832:             (FAR struct fb_overlayinfo_s *)((uintptr_t)arg);

1192: {
1193:   FAR struct inode *inode;
1194:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
1195:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
1196:   struct fb_panelinfo_s panelinfo;
1197:   int ret;
1198: 
1199:   /* Get the framebuffer instance */
1200: 
1201:   inode = filep->f_inode;
1202:   fb    = inode->i_private;
1203:   priv  = filep->f_priv;
1204: 
1205:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL && priv != NULL);
1206: 
1207:   /* Get panel info */
1208: 
1209:   ret = fb_get_panelinfo(fb, &panelinfo, priv->overlay);
1210: 
1211:   if (ret < 0)
1212:     {
1213:       return ret;
1214:     }
1215: 
1216:   /* Return the address corresponding to the start of frame buffer. */
1217: 
1218:   if (map->offset >= 0 && map->offset < panelinfo.fblen &&
1219:       map->length && map->offset + map->length <= panelinfo.fblen)
1220:     {
1221: #ifdef CONFIG_BUILD_KERNEL
1222:       map->vaddr = vm_map_region(get_current_mm(),
1223:                                  (uintptr_t)panelinfo.fbmem + map->offset,
1224:                                  panelinfo.fblen);
1225:       map->length = panelinfo.fblen;
1226:       map->munmap = fb_munmap;
1227:       mm_map_add(get_current_mm(), map);
1228: #else
1229:       map->vaddr = (FAR char *)panelinfo.fbmem + map->offset;
1230: #endif
1231:       return OK;
1232:     }
1233: 
1234:   return -EINVAL;
1235: }

1237: /****************************************************************************
1238:  * Name: fb_poll
1239:  *
1240:  * Description:
1241:  *   Wait for framebuffer to be writable.
1242:  *
1243:  ****************************************************************************/
1244: 
1245: static int fb_poll(FAR struct file *filep, struct pollfd *fds, bool setup)
1246: {
1247:   FAR struct inode *inode;
1248:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb;
1249:   FAR struct fb_priv_s *priv;
1250:   FAR struct circbuf_s *panbuf;
1251:   FAR struct pollfd **pollfds = NULL;
1252:   irqstate_t flags;
1253:   int ret = OK;
1254:   int i;
1255: 
1256:   /* Get the framebuffer instance */
1257: 
1258:   inode = filep->f_inode;
1259:   fb    = inode->i_private;
1260:   priv  = filep->f_priv;
1261: 
1262:   DEBUGASSERT(fb->vtable != NULL && priv != NULL);
1263: 
1264:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave_nopreempt(&fb->lock);
1265: 
1266:   if (setup)
1267:     {
1268:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_VIDEO_FB_NPOLLWAITERS; ++i)
1269:         {
1270:           if (!priv->fds[i])
1271:             {
1272:               pollfds = &priv->fds[i];
1273:               break;
1274:             }
1275:         }
1276: 
1277:       if (pollfds == NULL)
1278:         {
1279:           ret = -EBUSY;
1280:           goto errout;
1281:         }
1282: 
1283:       *pollfds = fds;
1284:       fds->priv = pollfds;
1285: 
1286:       panbuf = fb_get_panbuf(fb, priv->overlay);
1287:       if (!circbuf_is_full(panbuf))
1288:         {
1289:           poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLOUT);
1290:         }
1291:     }
1292:   else if (fds->priv != NULL)
1293:     {
1294:       /* This is a request to tear down the poll. */
1295: 
1296:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
1297:       *slot = NULL;
1298:       fds->priv = NULL;
1299:     }
1300: 
1301: errout:
1302:   spin_unlock_irqrestore_nopreempt(&fb->lock, flags);
1303:   return ret;
1304: }

1390: /****************************************************************************
1391:  * Name: fb_do_pollnotify
1392:  ****************************************************************************/
1393: 
1394: static void fb_do_pollnotify(wdparm_t arg)
1395: {
1396:   FAR struct fb_paninfo_s *paninfo = (FAR struct fb_paninfo_s *)arg;
1397:   FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb = paninfo->dev;
1398:   FAR struct fb_priv_s * priv;
1399:   irqstate_t flags;
1400:   int overlay;
1401: 
1402:   overlay = paninfo - paninfo->dev->paninfo - 1;
1403: 
1404:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave_nopreempt(&fb->lock);
1405:   for (priv = paninfo->dev->head; priv; priv = priv->flink)
1406:     {
1407:       if (priv->overlay != overlay)
1408:         {
1409:           continue;
1410:         }
1411: 
1412:       /* Notify framebuffer is writable. */
1413: 
1414:       poll_notify(priv->fds, CONFIG_VIDEO_FB_NPOLLWAITERS, POLLOUT);
1415:     }
1416: 
1417:   spin_unlock_irqrestore_nopreempt(&fb->lock, flags);
1418: }

1436:     }

1446: /****************************************************************************
1447:  * Name: fb_sem_post
1448:  ****************************************************************************/
1449: 
1450: static void fb_sem_post(FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb, int overlay)
1451: {
1452:   FAR struct fb_priv_s * priv;
1453:   irqstate_t flags;
1454: 
1455:   DEBUGASSERT(fb != NULL);
1456: 
1457:   flags = spin_lock_irqsave_nopreempt(&fb->lock);
1458: 
1459:   for (priv = fb->head; priv; priv = priv->flink)
1460:     {
1461:       if (priv->overlay != overlay)
1462:         {
1463:           continue;
1464:         }
1465: 
1466:       for (; ; )
1467:         {
1468:           int semcount = 0;
1469: 
1470:           sem_getvalue(&priv->wait, &semcount);
1471:           if (semcount >= 0)
1472:             {
1473:               break;
1474:             }
1475: 
1476:           /* Wakeup all waiters. */
1477: 
1478:           nxsem_post(&priv->wait);
1479:         }
1480:     }
1481: 
1482:   spin_unlock_irqrestore_nopreempt(&fb->lock, flags);
1483: }

1486: /****************************************************************************
1487:  * Name: fb_pollnotify
1488:  *
1489:  * Description:
1490:  *   Notify the waiting thread that the framebuffer can be written.
1491:  *
1492:  * Input Parameters:
1493:  *   vtable - Pointer to framebuffer's virtual table.
1494:  *
1495:  ****************************************************************************/
1496: 
1497: static void fb_pollnotify(FAR struct fb_chardev_s *fb, int overlay)
1498: {
1499:   int id = overlay + 1;
1500:

1762:   ret = vtable->getvideoinfo(vtable, &vinfo);

1770:   DEBUGASSERT(vinfo.nplanes > 0 && (unsigned)plane < vinfo.nplanes);

1772: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_OVERLAY
1773:   fb->paninfo_count = vinfo.noverlays;

1777: 
1778:   fb->paninfo_count += 1;
1779:   fb->paninfo = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct fb_paninfo_s) * fb->paninfo_count);
1780: 
1781:   if (fb->paninfo == NULL)
1782:     {

1784:       goto errout_with_fb;
1785:     }

1793:         }

1795:       ret = circbuf_init(&(fb->paninfo[i].buf), NULL, panelinfo.fbcount
1796:                          * sizeof(union fb_paninfo_u));

1798:       DEBUGASSERT(ret == 0);

1800:       fb->paninfo[i].dev = fb;

1802:       /* Clear the framebuffer memory */
1803: 
1804:       memset(panelinfo.fbmem, 0, panelinfo.fblen);
1805:     }
1806: 
1807:   /* Register the framebuffer device */
1808: 
1809:   if (nplanes < 2)
1810:     {
1811:       snprintf(devname, sizeof(devname), "/dev/fb%d", display);
1812:     }
1813:   else
1814:     {
1815:       snprintf(devname, sizeof(devname), "/dev/fb%d.%d", display, plane);
1816:     }

1818:   ret = register_driver(devname, &g_fb_fops, 0666, fb);

1822:       gerr("ERROR: register_driver() failed: %d\n", ret);
1823:       goto errout_with_paninfo;
1824:     }

1826:   vtable->priv = fb;

1832:     {
1833:       circbuf_uninit(&(fb->paninfo[i].buf));
1834:     }
1835:

142:     bool should_draw = com_clip_res || lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_OVERFLOW_VISIBLE);
143:     if(should_draw) {
144:         draw_ctx->clip_area = &clip_coords_for_obj;
145: 
146:         lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_DRAW_MAIN_BEGIN, draw_ctx);
147:         lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_DRAW_MAIN, draw_ctx);
148:         lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_DRAW_MAIN_END, draw_ctx);
149: #if LV_USE_REFR_DEBUG
150:         lv_color_t debug_color = lv_color_make(lv_rand(0, 0xFF), lv_rand(0, 0xFF), lv_rand(0, 0xFF));
151:         lv_draw_rect_dsc_t draw_dsc;
152:         lv_draw_rect_dsc_init(&draw_dsc);
153:         draw_dsc.bg_color.full = debug_color.full;
154:         draw_dsc.bg_opa = LV_OPA_20;
155:         draw_dsc.border_width = 1;
156:         draw_dsc.border_opa = LV_OPA_30;
157:         draw_dsc.border_color = debug_color;
158:         lv_draw_rect(draw_ctx, &draw_dsc, &obj_coords_ext);
159: #endif
160:     }
161: 
162:     /*With overflow visible keep the previous clip area to let the children visible out of this object too
163:      *With not overflow visible limit the clip are to the object's coordinates to clip the children*/
164:     lv_area_t clip_coords_for_children;
165:     bool refr_children = true;
166:     if(lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_OVERFLOW_VISIBLE)) {
167:         clip_coords_for_children  = *clip_area_ori;
168:     }
169:     else {
170:         if(!_lv_area_intersect(&clip_coords_for_children, clip_area_ori, &obj->coords)) {
171:             refr_children = false;
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:     if(refr_children) {
176:         draw_ctx->clip_area = &clip_coords_for_children;
177:         uint32_t i;
178:         uint32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_cnt(obj);
179:         for(i = 0; i < child_cnt; i++) {
180:             lv_obj_t * child = obj->spec_attr->children[i];
181:             refr_obj(draw_ctx, child);
182:         }
183:     }
184: 
185:     /*If the object was visible on the clip area call the post draw events too*/
186:     if(should_draw) {
187:         draw_ctx->clip_area = &clip_coords_for_obj;
188: 
189:         /*If all the children are redrawn make 'post draw' draw*/
190:         lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_BEGIN, draw_ctx);
191:         lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST, draw_ctx);
192:         lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_END, draw_ctx);
193:     }
194: 
195:     draw_ctx->clip_area = clip_area_ori;
196: }

199: /**
200:  * Invalidate an area on display to redraw it
201:  * @param area_p pointer to area which should be invalidated (NULL: delete the invalidated areas)
202:  * @param disp pointer to display where the area should be invalidated (NULL can be used if there is
203:  * only one display)
204:  */
205: void _lv_inv_area(lv_disp_t * disp, const lv_area_t * area_p)
206: {
207:     if(!disp) disp = lv_disp_get_default();
208:     if(!disp) return;
209:     if(!lv_disp_is_invalidation_enabled(disp)) return;
210: 
211:     if(disp->rendering_in_progress) {
212:         LV_LOG_ERROR("detected modifying dirty areas in render");
213:         return;
214:     }
215: 
216:     /*Clear the invalidate buffer if the parameter is NULL*/
217:     if(area_p == NULL) {
218:         disp->inv_p = 0;
219:         return;
220:     }
221: 
222:     lv_area_t scr_area;
223:     scr_area.x1 = 0;
224:     scr_area.y1 = 0;
225:     scr_area.x2 = lv_disp_get_hor_res(disp) - 1;
226:     scr_area.y2 = lv_disp_get_ver_res(disp) - 1;
227: 
228:     lv_area_t com_area;
229:     bool suc;
230: 
231:     suc = _lv_area_intersect(&com_area, area_p, &scr_area);
232:     if(suc == false)  return; /*Out of the screen*/
233: 
234:     /*If there were at least 1 invalid area in full refresh mode, redraw the whole screen*/
235:     if(disp->driver->full_refresh) {
236:         disp->inv_areas[0] = scr_area;
237:         disp->inv_p = 1;
238:         if(disp->refr_timer) lv_timer_resume(disp->refr_timer);
239:         return;
240:     }
241: 
242:     if(disp->driver->rounder_cb) disp->driver->rounder_cb(disp->driver, &com_area);
243: 
244:     /*Save only if this area is not in one of the saved areas*/
245:     uint16_t i;
246:     for(i = 0; i < disp->inv_p; i++) {
247:         if(_lv_area_is_in(&com_area, &disp->inv_areas[i], 0) != false) return;
248:     }
249: 
250:     /*Save the area*/
251:     if(disp->inv_p < LV_INV_BUF_SIZE) {
252:         lv_area_copy(&disp->inv_areas[disp->inv_p], &com_area);
253:     }
254:     else {   /*If no place for the area add the screen*/
255:         disp->inv_p = 0;
256:         lv_area_copy(&disp->inv_areas[disp->inv_p], &scr_area);
257:     }
258:     disp->inv_p++;
259:     if(disp->refr_timer) lv_timer_resume(disp->refr_timer);
260: }

282: /**
283:  * Called periodically to handle the refreshing
284:  * @param tmr pointer to the timer itself
285:  */
286: void _lv_disp_refr_timer(lv_timer_t * tmr)
287: {
288:     REFR_TRACE("begin");
289: 
290:     uint32_t start = lv_tick_get();
291:     volatile uint32_t elaps = 0;
292: 
293:     if(tmr) {
294:         disp_refr = tmr->user_data;
295: #if LV_USE_PERF_MONITOR == 0 && LV_USE_MEM_MONITOR == 0
296:         /**
297:          * Ensure the timer does not run again automatically.
298:          * This is done before refreshing in case refreshing invalidates something else.
299:          */
300:         lv_timer_pause(tmr);
301: #endif
302:     }
303:     else {
304:         disp_refr = lv_disp_get_default();
305:     }
306: 
307:     /*Refresh the screen's layout if required*/
308:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->act_scr);
309:     if(disp_refr->prev_scr) lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->prev_scr);
310: 
311:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->top_layer);
312:     lv_obj_update_layout(disp_refr->sys_layer);
313: 
314:     /*Do nothing if there is no active screen*/
315:     if(disp_refr->act_scr == NULL) {
316:         disp_refr->inv_p = 0;
317:         LV_LOG_WARN("there is no active screen");
318:         REFR_TRACE("finished");
319:         return;
320:     }
321: 
322:     lv_refr_join_area();
323: 
324:     refr_invalid_areas();
325: 
326:     /*If refresh happened ...*/
327:     if(disp_refr->inv_p != 0) {
328: 
329:         /*Clean up*/
330:         lv_memset_00(disp_refr->inv_areas, sizeof(disp_refr->inv_areas));
331:         lv_memset_00(disp_refr->inv_area_joined, sizeof(disp_refr->inv_area_joined));
332:         disp_refr->inv_p = 0;
333: 
334:         elaps = lv_tick_elaps(start);
335: 
336:         /*Call monitor cb if present*/
337:         if(disp_refr->driver->monitor_cb) {
338:             disp_refr->driver->monitor_cb(disp_refr->driver, elaps, px_num);
339:         }
340:     }
341: 
342:     lv_mem_buf_free_all();
343:     _lv_font_clean_up_fmt_txt();
344: 
345: #if LV_DRAW_COMPLEX
346:     _lv_draw_mask_cleanup();
347: #endif
348: 
349: #if LV_USE_PERF_MONITOR && LV_USE_LABEL
350:     lv_obj_t * perf_label = perf_monitor.perf_label;
351:     if(perf_label == NULL) {
352:         perf_label = lv_label_create(lv_layer_sys());
353:         lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(perf_label, LV_OPA_50, 0);
354:         lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(perf_label, lv_color_black(), 0);
355:         lv_obj_set_style_text_color(perf_label, lv_color_white(), 0);
356:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_top(perf_label, 3, 0);
357:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_bottom(perf_label, 3, 0);
358:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_left(perf_label, 3, 0);
359:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_right(perf_label, 3, 0);
360:         lv_obj_set_style_text_align(perf_label, LV_TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT, 0);
361:         lv_label_set_text(perf_label, "?");
362:         lv_obj_align(perf_label, LV_USE_PERF_MONITOR_POS, 0, 0);
363:         perf_monitor.perf_label = perf_label;
364:     }
365: 
366:     if(lv_tick_elaps(perf_monitor.perf_last_time) < 300) {
367:         if(px_num > 5000) {
368:             perf_monitor.elaps_sum += elaps;
369:             perf_monitor.frame_cnt ++;
370:         }
371:     }
372:     else {
373:         perf_monitor.perf_last_time = lv_tick_get();
374:         uint32_t fps_limit;
375:         uint32_t fps;
376: 
377:         if(disp_refr->refr_timer) {
378:             fps_limit = 1000 / disp_refr->refr_timer->period;
379:         }
380:         else {
381:             fps_limit = 1000 / LV_DISP_DEF_REFR_PERIOD;
382:         }
383: 
384:         if(perf_monitor.elaps_sum == 0) {
385:             perf_monitor.elaps_sum = 1;
386:         }
387:         if(perf_monitor.frame_cnt == 0) {
388:             fps = fps_limit;
389:         }
390:         else {
391:             fps = (1000 * perf_monitor.frame_cnt) / perf_monitor.elaps_sum;
392:         }
393:         perf_monitor.elaps_sum = 0;
394:         perf_monitor.frame_cnt = 0;
395:         if(fps > fps_limit) {
396:             fps = fps_limit;
397:         }
398: 
399:         perf_monitor.fps_sum_all += fps;
400:         perf_monitor.fps_sum_cnt ++;
401:         uint32_t cpu = 100 - lv_timer_get_idle();
402:         lv_label_set_text_fmt(perf_label, "%"LV_PRIu32" FPS\n%"LV_PRIu32"%% CPU", fps, cpu);
403:     }
404: #endif
405: 
406: #if LV_USE_MEM_MONITOR && LV_MEM_CUSTOM == 0 && LV_USE_LABEL
407:     lv_obj_t * mem_label = mem_monitor.mem_label;
408:     if(mem_label == NULL) {
409:         mem_label = lv_label_create(lv_layer_sys());
410:         lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(mem_label, LV_OPA_50, 0);
411:         lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(mem_label, lv_color_black(), 0);
412:         lv_obj_set_style_text_color(mem_label, lv_color_white(), 0);
413:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_top(mem_label, 3, 0);
414:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_bottom(mem_label, 3, 0);
415:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_left(mem_label, 3, 0);
416:         lv_obj_set_style_pad_right(mem_label, 3, 0);

418:         lv_obj_align(mem_label, LV_USE_MEM_MONITOR_POS, 0, 0);
419:         mem_monitor.mem_label = mem_label;
420:     }
421: 
422:     if(lv_tick_elaps(mem_monitor.mem_last_time) > 300) {
423:         mem_monitor.mem_last_time = lv_tick_get();
424:         lv_mem_monitor_t mon;
425:         lv_mem_monitor(&mon);
426:         uint32_t used_size = mon.total_size - mon.free_size;;
427:         uint32_t used_kb = used_size / 1024;

429:         lv_label_set_text_fmt(mem_label,
430:                               "%"LV_PRIu32 ".%"LV_PRIu32 " kB used (%d %%)\n"
431:                               "%d%% frag.",
432:                               used_kb, used_kb_tenth, mon.used_pct,
433:                               mon.frag_pct);
434:     }
435: #endif
436: 
437:     REFR_TRACE("finished");

461: /**
462:  * Join the areas which has got common parts
463:  */
464: static void lv_refr_join_area(void)
465: {
466:     uint32_t join_from;
467:     uint32_t join_in;
468:     lv_area_t joined_area;
469:     for(join_in = 0; join_in < disp_refr->inv_p; join_in++) {
470:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[join_in] != 0) continue;
471: 
472:         /*Check all areas to join them in 'join_in'*/
473:         for(join_from = 0; join_from < disp_refr->inv_p; join_from++) {
474:             /*Handle only unjoined areas and ignore itself*/
475:             if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[join_from] != 0 || join_in == join_from) {
476:                 continue;
477:             }
478: 
479:             /*Check if the areas are on each other*/
480:             if(_lv_area_is_on(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in], &disp_refr->inv_areas[join_from]) == false) {
481:                 continue;
482:             }
483: 
484:             _lv_area_join(&joined_area, &disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in], &disp_refr->inv_areas[join_from]);
485: 
486:             /*Join two area only if the joined area size is smaller*/
487:             if(lv_area_get_size(&joined_area) < (lv_area_get_size(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in]) +
488:                                                  lv_area_get_size(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_from]))) {
489:                 lv_area_copy(&disp_refr->inv_areas[join_in], &joined_area);
490: 
491:                 /*Mark 'join_form' is joined into 'join_in'*/
492:                 disp_refr->inv_area_joined[join_from] = 1;
493:             }
494:         }
495:     }
496: }
497: 
498: /**
499:  * Refresh the joined areas
500:  */
501: static void refr_invalid_areas(void)
502: {
503:     px_num = 0;
504: 
505:     if(disp_refr->inv_p == 0) return;
506: 
507:     /*Find the last area which will be drawn*/
508:     int32_t i;
509:     int32_t last_i = 0;
510:     for(i = disp_refr->inv_p - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
511:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[i] == 0) {
512:             last_i = i;
513:             break;
514:         }
515:     }
516: 
517:     /*Notify the display driven rendering has started*/
518:     if(disp_refr->driver->render_start_cb) {
519:         disp_refr->driver->render_start_cb(disp_refr->driver);
520:     }
521: 
522:     disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_area = 0;
523:     disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_part = 0;
524:     disp_refr->rendering_in_progress = true;
525: 
526:     for(i = 0; i < disp_refr->inv_p; i++) {
527:         /*Refresh the unjoined areas*/
528:         if(disp_refr->inv_area_joined[i] == 0) {
529: 
530:             if(i == last_i) disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_area = 1;
531:             disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_part = 0;
532:             refr_area(&disp_refr->inv_areas[i]);
533: 
534:             px_num += lv_area_get_size(&disp_refr->inv_areas[i]);
535:         }
536:     }
537: 
538:     disp_refr->rendering_in_progress = false;
539: }

541: /**
542:  * Refresh an area if there is Virtual Display Buffer
543:  * @param area_p  pointer to an area to refresh
544:  */
545: static void refr_area(const lv_area_t * area_p)
546: {
547:     lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx = disp_refr->driver->draw_ctx;
548:     draw_ctx->buf = disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->buf_act;
549: 
550:     /*With full refresh just redraw directly into the buffer*/
551:     /*In direct mode draw directly on the absolute coordinates of the buffer*/
552:     if(disp_refr->driver->full_refresh || disp_refr->driver->direct_mode) {
553:         lv_area_t disp_area;
554:         lv_area_set(&disp_area, 0, 0, lv_disp_get_hor_res(disp_refr) - 1, lv_disp_get_ver_res(disp_refr) - 1);
555:         draw_ctx->buf_area = &disp_area;
556: 
557:         if(disp_refr->driver->full_refresh) {
558:             disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_part = 1;
559:             draw_ctx->clip_area = &disp_area;
560:             refr_area_part(draw_ctx);
561:         }
562:         else {
563:             disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_part = disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_area;
564:             draw_ctx->clip_area = area_p;
565:             refr_area_part(draw_ctx);
566:         }
567:         return;
568:     }
569: 
570:     /*Normal refresh: draw the area in parts*/
571:     /*Calculate the max row num*/
572:     lv_coord_t w = lv_area_get_width(area_p);
573:     lv_coord_t h = lv_area_get_height(area_p);
574:     lv_coord_t y2 = area_p->y2 >= lv_disp_get_ver_res(disp_refr) ?
575:                     lv_disp_get_ver_res(disp_refr) - 1 : area_p->y2;
576: 
577:     int32_t max_row = get_max_row(disp_refr, w, h);
578: 
579:     lv_coord_t row;
580:     lv_coord_t row_last = 0;
581:     lv_area_t sub_area;
582:     for(row = area_p->y1; row + max_row - 1 <= y2; row += max_row) {
583:         /*Calc. the next y coordinates of draw_buf*/
584:         sub_area.x1 = area_p->x1;
585:         sub_area.x2 = area_p->x2;
586:         sub_area.y1 = row;
587:         sub_area.y2 = row + max_row - 1;
588:         draw_ctx->buf_area = &sub_area;
589:         draw_ctx->clip_area = &sub_area;
590:         draw_ctx->buf = disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->buf_act;
591:         if(sub_area.y2 > y2) sub_area.y2 = y2;
592:         row_last = sub_area.y2;
593:         if(y2 == row_last) disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_part = 1;
594:         refr_area_part(draw_ctx);
595:     }
596: 
597:     /*If the last y coordinates are not handled yet ...*/
598:     if(y2 != row_last) {
599:         /*Calc. the next y coordinates of draw_buf*/
600:         sub_area.x1 = area_p->x1;
601:         sub_area.x2 = area_p->x2;
602:         sub_area.y1 = row;
603:         sub_area.y2 = y2;
604:         draw_ctx->buf_area = &sub_area;
605:         draw_ctx->clip_area = &sub_area;
606:         draw_ctx->buf = disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->buf_act;
607:         disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->last_part = 1;
608:         refr_area_part(draw_ctx);
609:     }
610: }
611: 
612: static void refr_area_part(lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx)
613: {
614:     lv_disp_draw_buf_t * draw_buf = lv_disp_get_draw_buf(disp_refr);
615: 
616:     /* Below the `area_p` area will be redrawn into the draw buffer.
617:      * In single buffered mode wait here until the buffer is freed.
618:      * In full double buffered mode wait here while the buffers are swapped and a buffer becomes available*/
619:     bool full_sized = draw_buf->size == (uint32_t)disp_refr->driver->hor_res * disp_refr->driver->ver_res;
620:     if((draw_buf->buf1 && !draw_buf->buf2) ||
621:        (draw_buf->buf1 && draw_buf->buf2 && full_sized)) {
622:         while(draw_buf->flushing) {
623:             if(disp_refr->driver->wait_cb) disp_refr->driver->wait_cb(disp_refr->driver);
624:         }
625: 
626:         /*If the screen is transparent initialize it when the flushing is ready*/
627: #if LV_COLOR_SCREEN_TRANSP
628:         if(disp_refr->driver->screen_transp) {
629:             if(disp_refr->driver->clear_cb) {
630:                 disp_refr->driver->clear_cb(disp_refr->driver, disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->buf_act, disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->size);
631:             }
632:             else {
633:                 lv_memset_00(disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->buf_act, disp_refr->driver->draw_buf->size * LV_IMG_PX_SIZE_ALPHA_BYTE);
634:             }
635:         }
636: #endif
637:     }
638: 
639:     lv_obj_t * top_act_scr = NULL;
640:     lv_obj_t * top_prev_scr = NULL;
641: 
642:     /*Get the most top object which is not covered by others*/
643:     top_act_scr = lv_refr_get_top_obj(draw_ctx->buf_area, lv_disp_get_scr_act(disp_refr));
644:     if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
645:         top_prev_scr = lv_refr_get_top_obj(draw_ctx->buf_area, disp_refr->prev_scr);
646:     }
647: 
648:     /*Draw a display background if there is no top object*/
649:     if(top_act_scr == NULL && top_prev_scr == NULL) {
650:         lv_area_t a;
651:         lv_area_set(&a, 0, 0,
652:                     lv_disp_get_hor_res(disp_refr) - 1, lv_disp_get_ver_res(disp_refr) - 1);
653:         if(draw_ctx->draw_bg) {
654:             lv_draw_rect_dsc_t dsc;
655:             lv_draw_rect_dsc_init(&dsc);
656:             dsc.bg_img_src = disp_refr->bg_img;
657:             dsc.bg_img_opa = disp_refr->bg_opa;
658:             dsc.bg_color = disp_refr->bg_color;
659:             dsc.bg_opa = disp_refr->bg_opa;
660:             draw_ctx->draw_bg(draw_ctx, &dsc, &a);
661:         }
662:         else if(disp_refr->bg_img) {
663:             lv_img_header_t header;
664:             lv_res_t res = lv_img_decoder_get_info(disp_refr->bg_img, &header);
665:             if(res == LV_RES_OK) {
666:                 lv_draw_img_dsc_t dsc;
667:                 lv_draw_img_dsc_init(&dsc);
668:                 dsc.opa = disp_refr->bg_opa;
669:                 lv_draw_img(draw_ctx, &dsc, &a, disp_refr->bg_img);
670:             }
671:             else {
672:                 LV_LOG_WARN("Can't draw the background image");
673:             }
674:         }
675:         else {
676:             lv_draw_rect_dsc_t dsc;
677:             lv_draw_rect_dsc_init(&dsc);
678:             dsc.bg_color = disp_refr->bg_color;
679:             dsc.bg_opa = disp_refr->bg_opa;
680:             lv_draw_rect(draw_ctx, &dsc, draw_ctx->buf_area);
681:         }
682:     }
683: 
684:     if(disp_refr->draw_prev_over_act) {
685:         if(top_act_scr == NULL) top_act_scr = disp_refr->act_scr;
686:         refr_obj_and_children(draw_ctx, top_act_scr);
687: 
688:         /*Refresh the previous screen if any*/
689:         if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
690:             if(top_prev_scr == NULL) top_prev_scr = disp_refr->prev_scr;
691:             refr_obj_and_children(draw_ctx, top_prev_scr);
692:         }
693:     }
694:     else {
695:         /*Refresh the previous screen if any*/
696:         if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
697:             if(top_prev_scr == NULL) top_prev_scr = disp_refr->prev_scr;
698:             refr_obj_and_children(draw_ctx, top_prev_scr);
699:         }
700: 
701:         if(top_act_scr == NULL) top_act_scr = disp_refr->act_scr;
702:         refr_obj_and_children(draw_ctx, top_act_scr);
703:     }
704: 
705:     /*Also refresh top and sys layer unconditionally*/
706:     refr_obj_and_children(draw_ctx, lv_disp_get_layer_top(disp_refr));
707:     refr_obj_and_children(draw_ctx, lv_disp_get_layer_sys(disp_refr));
708: 
709:     draw_buf_flush(disp_refr);
710: }

712: /**
713:  * Search the most top object which fully covers an area
714:  * @param area_p pointer to an area
715:  * @param obj the first object to start the searching (typically a screen)
716:  * @return
717:  */
718: static lv_obj_t * lv_refr_get_top_obj(const lv_area_t * area_p, lv_obj_t * obj)
719: {
720:     lv_obj_t * found_p = NULL;
721: 
722:     if(_lv_area_is_in(area_p, &obj->coords, 0) == false) return NULL;
723:     if(lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN)) return NULL;
724:     if(_lv_obj_get_layer_type(obj) != LV_LAYER_TYPE_NONE) return NULL;
725: 
726:     /*If this object is fully cover the draw area then check the children too*/
727:     lv_cover_check_info_t info;
728:     info.res = LV_COVER_RES_COVER;
729:     info.area = area_p;
730:     lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_COVER_CHECK, &info);
731:     if(info.res == LV_COVER_RES_MASKED) return NULL;
732: 
733:     int32_t i;
734:     int32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_cnt(obj);
735:     for(i = child_cnt - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
736:         lv_obj_t * child = obj->spec_attr->children[i];
737:         found_p = lv_refr_get_top_obj(area_p, child);
738: 
739:         /*If a children is ok then break*/
740:         if(found_p != NULL) {
741:             break;
742:         }
743:     }
744: 
745:     /*If no better children use this object*/
746:     if(found_p == NULL && info.res == LV_COVER_RES_COVER) {
747:         found_p = obj;
748:     }
749: 
750:     return found_p;
751: }

753: /**
754:  * Make the refreshing from an object. Draw all its children and the youngers too.
755:  * @param top_p pointer to an objects. Start the drawing from it.
756:  * @param mask_p pointer to an area, the objects will be drawn only here
757:  */
758: static void refr_obj_and_children(lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx, lv_obj_t * top_obj)
759: {
760:     /*Normally always will be a top_obj (at least the screen)
761:      *but in special cases (e.g. if the screen has alpha) it won't.
762:      *In this case use the screen directly*/
763:     if(top_obj == NULL) top_obj = lv_disp_get_scr_act(disp_refr);
764:     if(top_obj == NULL) return;  /*Shouldn't happen*/
765: 
766:     /*Refresh the top object and its children*/
767:     refr_obj(draw_ctx, top_obj);
768: 
769:     /*Draw the 'younger' sibling objects because they can be on top_obj*/
770:     lv_obj_t * parent;
771:     lv_obj_t * border_p = top_obj;
772: 
773:     parent = lv_obj_get_parent(top_obj);
774: 
775:     /*Do until not reach the screen*/
776:     while(parent != NULL) {
777:         bool go = false;
778:         uint32_t i;
779:         uint32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_cnt(parent);
780:         for(i = 0; i < child_cnt; i++) {
781:             lv_obj_t * child = parent->spec_attr->children[i];
782:             if(!go) {
783:                 if(child == border_p) go = true;
784:             }
785:             else {
786:                 /*Refresh the objects*/
787:                 refr_obj(draw_ctx, child);
788:             }
789:         }
790: 
791:         /*Call the post draw draw function of the parents of the to object*/
792:         lv_event_send(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_BEGIN, (void *)draw_ctx);
793:         lv_event_send(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST, (void *)draw_ctx);
794:         lv_event_send(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_END, (void *)draw_ctx);
795: 
796:         /*The new border will be the last parents,
797:          *so the 'younger' brothers of parent will be refreshed*/
798:         border_p = parent;
799:         /*Go a level deeper*/
800:         parent = lv_obj_get_parent(parent);
801:     }
802: }

805: static lv_res_t layer_get_area(lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx, lv_obj_t * obj, lv_layer_type_t layer_type,
806:                                lv_area_t * layer_area_out)
807: {
808:     lv_coord_t ext_draw_size = _lv_obj_get_ext_draw_size(obj);
809:     lv_area_t obj_coords_ext;
810:     lv_obj_get_coords(obj, &obj_coords_ext);
811:     lv_area_increase(&obj_coords_ext, ext_draw_size, ext_draw_size);
812: 
813:     if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_TRANSFORM) {
814:         /*Get the transformed area and clip it to the current clip area.
815:          *This area needs to be updated on the screen.*/
816:         lv_area_t clip_coords_for_obj;
817:         lv_area_t tranf_coords = obj_coords_ext;
818:         lv_obj_get_transformed_area(obj, &tranf_coords, false, false);
819:         if(!_lv_area_intersect(&clip_coords_for_obj, draw_ctx->clip_area, &tranf_coords)) {
820:             return LV_RES_INV;
821:         }
822: 
823:         /*Transform back (inverse) the transformed area.
824:          *It will tell which area of the non-transformed widget needs to be redrawn
825:          *in order to cover transformed area after transformation.*/
826:         lv_area_t inverse_clip_coords_for_obj = clip_coords_for_obj;
827:         lv_obj_get_transformed_area(obj, &inverse_clip_coords_for_obj, false, true);
828:         if(!_lv_area_intersect(&inverse_clip_coords_for_obj, &inverse_clip_coords_for_obj, &obj_coords_ext)) {
829:             return LV_RES_INV;
830:         }
831: 
832:         *layer_area_out = inverse_clip_coords_for_obj;
833:     }
834:     else if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_SIMPLE) {
835:         lv_area_t clip_coords_for_obj;
836:         if(!_lv_area_intersect(&clip_coords_for_obj, draw_ctx->clip_area, &obj_coords_ext)) {
837:             return LV_RES_INV;
838:         }
839:         *layer_area_out = clip_coords_for_obj;
840:     }
841:     else {
842:         LV_LOG_WARN("Unhandled intermediate layer type");
843:         return LV_RES_INV;
844:     }
845: 
846:     return LV_RES_OK;
847: }

849: static void layer_alpha_test(lv_obj_t * obj, lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx, lv_draw_layer_ctx_t * layer_ctx,
850:                              lv_draw_layer_flags_t flags)
851: {
852:     bool has_alpha;
853:     /*If globally the layer has alpha maybe this smaller section has not (e.g. not on a rounded corner)
854:      *If turns out that this section has no alpha renderer can choose faster algorithms*/
855:     if(flags & LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_HAS_ALPHA) {
856:         /*Test for alpha by assuming there is no alpha. If it fails, fall back to rendering with alpha*/
857:         has_alpha = true;
858:         if(_lv_area_is_in(&layer_ctx->area_act, &obj->coords, 0)) {
859:             lv_cover_check_info_t info;
860:             info.res = LV_COVER_RES_COVER;
861:             info.area = &layer_ctx->area_act;
862:             lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_COVER_CHECK, &info);
863:             if(info.res == LV_COVER_RES_COVER) has_alpha = false;
864:         }
865: 
866:         if(has_alpha) {
867:             layer_ctx->area_act.y2 = layer_ctx->area_act.y1 + layer_ctx->max_row_with_alpha - 1;
868:         }
869:     }
870:     else {
871:         has_alpha = false;
872:     }
873: 
874:     if(layer_ctx->area_act.y2 > layer_ctx->area_full.y2) layer_ctx->area_act.y2 = layer_ctx->area_full.y2;
875:     lv_draw_layer_adjust(draw_ctx, layer_ctx, has_alpha ? LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_HAS_ALPHA : LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_NONE);
876: }

878: 
879: void refr_obj(lv_draw_ctx_t * draw_ctx, lv_obj_t * obj)
880: {
881:     /*Do not refresh hidden objects*/
882:     if(lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN)) return;
883:     lv_layer_type_t layer_type = _lv_obj_get_layer_type(obj);
884:     if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_NONE) {
885:         lv_obj_redraw(draw_ctx, obj);
886:     }
887:     else {
888:         lv_opa_t opa = lv_obj_get_style_opa(obj, 0);
889:         if(opa < LV_OPA_MIN) return;
890: 
891:         lv_area_t layer_area_full;
892:         lv_res_t res = layer_get_area(draw_ctx, obj, layer_type, &layer_area_full);
893:         if(res != LV_RES_OK) return;
894: 
895:         lv_draw_layer_flags_t flags = LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_HAS_ALPHA;
896: 
897:         if(_lv_area_is_in(&layer_area_full, &obj->coords, 0)) {
898:             lv_cover_check_info_t info;
899:             info.res = LV_COVER_RES_COVER;
900:             info.area = &layer_area_full;
901:             lv_event_send(obj, LV_EVENT_COVER_CHECK, &info);
902:             if(info.res == LV_COVER_RES_COVER) flags &= ~LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_HAS_ALPHA;
903:         }
904: 
905:         if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_SIMPLE) flags |= LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_CAN_SUBDIVIDE;
906: 
907:         lv_draw_layer_ctx_t * layer_ctx = lv_draw_layer_create(draw_ctx, &layer_area_full, flags);
908:         if(layer_ctx == NULL) {
909:             LV_LOG_WARN("Couldn't create a new layer context");
910:             return;
911:         }
912:         lv_point_t pivot = {
913:             .x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_pivot_x(obj, 0),
914:             .y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_pivot_y(obj, 0)
915:         };
916: 
917:         lv_draw_img_dsc_t draw_dsc;
918:         lv_draw_img_dsc_init(&draw_dsc);
919:         draw_dsc.opa = opa;
920:         draw_dsc.angle = lv_obj_get_style_transform_angle(obj, 0);
921:         if(draw_dsc.angle > 3600) draw_dsc.angle -= 3600;
922:         else if(draw_dsc.angle < 0) draw_dsc.angle += 3600;
923: 
924:         draw_dsc.zoom = lv_obj_get_style_transform_zoom(obj, 0);
925:         draw_dsc.blend_mode = lv_obj_get_style_blend_mode(obj, 0);
926:         draw_dsc.antialias = disp_refr->driver->antialiasing;
927: 
928:         if(flags & LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_CAN_SUBDIVIDE) {
929:             layer_ctx->area_act = layer_ctx->area_full;
930:             layer_ctx->area_act.y2 = layer_ctx->area_act.y1 + layer_ctx->max_row_with_no_alpha - 1;
931:             if(layer_ctx->area_act.y2 > layer_ctx->area_full.y2) layer_ctx->area_act.y2 = layer_ctx->area_full.y2;
932:         }
933: 
934:         while(layer_ctx->area_act.y1 <= layer_area_full.y2) {
935:             if(flags & LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_CAN_SUBDIVIDE) {
936:                 layer_alpha_test(obj, draw_ctx, layer_ctx, flags);
937:             }
938: 
939:             lv_obj_redraw(draw_ctx, obj);
940: 
941:             draw_dsc.pivot.x = obj->coords.x1 + pivot.x - draw_ctx->buf_area->x1;
942:             draw_dsc.pivot.y = obj->coords.y1 + pivot.y - draw_ctx->buf_area->y1;
943: 
944:             /*With LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_CAN_SUBDIVIDE it should also go the next chunk*/
945:             lv_draw_layer_blend(draw_ctx, layer_ctx, &draw_dsc);
946: 
947:             if((flags & LV_DRAW_LAYER_FLAG_CAN_SUBDIVIDE) == 0) break;
948: 
949:             layer_ctx->area_act.y1 = layer_ctx->area_act.y2 + 1;
950:             layer_ctx->area_act.y2 = layer_ctx->area_act.y1 + layer_ctx->max_row_with_no_alpha - 1;
951:         }
952: 
953:         lv_draw_layer_destroy(draw_ctx, layer_ctx);
954:     }
955: }
