610: /**
611:  * Refresh an area if there is Virtual Display Buffer
612:  * @param area_p  pointer to an area to refresh
613:  */
614: static void refr_area(const lv_area_t * area_p)
615: {
616:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
617:     lv_layer_t * layer = disp_refr->layer_head;
618:     layer->draw_buf = disp_refr->buf_act;
619: 
620: #if LV_DRAW_TRANSFORM_USE_MATRIX
621:     lv_matrix_identity(&layer->matrix);
622: #endif
623: 
624:     /*With full refresh just redraw directly into the buffer*/
625:     /*In direct mode draw directly on the absolute coordinates of the buffer*/
626:     if(disp_refr->render_mode != LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_PARTIAL) {
627:         layer->buf_area.x1 = 0;
628:         layer->buf_area.y1 = 0;
629:         layer->buf_area.x2 = lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp_refr) - 1;
630:         layer->buf_area.y2 = lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) - 1;
631:         lv_area_t disp_area;
632:         lv_area_set(&disp_area, 0, 0, lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp_refr) - 1,
633:                     lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) - 1);
634: 
635:         if(disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_FULL) {
636:             disp_refr->last_part = 1;
637:             layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, layer->draw_buf->header.stride);
638:             layer->_clip_area = disp_area;
639:             layer->phy_clip_area = disp_area;
640:             refr_area_part(layer);
641:         }
642:         else if(disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT) {
643:             disp_refr->last_part = disp_refr->last_area;
644:             layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, layer->draw_buf->header.stride);
645:             layer->_clip_area = *area_p;
646:             layer->phy_clip_area = *area_p;
647:             refr_area_part(layer);
648:         }
649:         LV_PROFILER_END;
650:         return;
651:     }
652: 
653:     /*Normal refresh: draw the area in parts*/
654:     /*Calculate the max row num*/
655:     int32_t w = lv_area_get_width(area_p);
656:     int32_t h = lv_area_get_height(area_p);
657:     int32_t y2 = area_p->y2 >= lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) ?
658:                  lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp_refr) - 1 : area_p->y2;
659: 
660:     int32_t max_row = get_max_row(disp_refr, w, h);
661: 
662:     int32_t row;
663:     int32_t row_last = 0;
664:     lv_area_t sub_area;
665:     for(row = area_p->y1; row + max_row - 1 <= y2; row += max_row) {
666:         /*Calc. the next y coordinates of draw_buf*/
667:         sub_area.x1 = area_p->x1;
668:         sub_area.x2 = area_p->x2;
669:         sub_area.y1 = row;
670:         sub_area.y2 = row + max_row - 1;
671:         layer->draw_buf = disp_refr->buf_act;
672:         layer->buf_area = sub_area;
673:         layer->_clip_area = sub_area;
674:         layer->phy_clip_area = sub_area;
675:         layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, LV_STRIDE_AUTO);
676:         if(sub_area.y2 > y2) sub_area.y2 = y2;
677:         row_last = sub_area.y2;
678:         if(y2 == row_last) disp_refr->last_part = 1;
679:         refr_area_part(layer);
680:     }
681: 
682:     /*If the last y coordinates are not handled yet ...*/
683:     if(y2 != row_last) {
684:         /*Calc. the next y coordinates of draw_buf*/
685:         sub_area.x1 = area_p->x1;
686:         sub_area.x2 = area_p->x2;
687:         sub_area.y1 = row;
688:         sub_area.y2 = y2;
689:         layer->draw_buf = disp_refr->buf_act;
690:         layer->buf_area = sub_area;
691:         layer->_clip_area = sub_area;
692:         layer->phy_clip_area = sub_area;
693:         layer_reshape_draw_buf(layer, LV_STRIDE_AUTO);
694:         disp_refr->last_part = 1;
695:         refr_area_part(layer);
696:     }
697:     LV_PROFILER_END;
698: }
699: 
700: static void refr_area_part(lv_layer_t * layer)
701: {
702:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
703:     disp_refr->refreshed_area = layer->_clip_area;
704: 
705:     /* In single buffered mode wait here until the buffer is freed.
706:      * Else we would draw into the buffer while it's still being transferred to the display*/
707:     if(!lv_display_is_double_buffered(disp_refr)) {
708:         wait_for_flushing(disp_refr);
709:     }
710:     /*If the screen is transparent initialize it when the flushing is ready*/
711:     if(lv_color_format_has_alpha(disp_refr->color_format)) {
712:         lv_area_t a = disp_refr->refreshed_area;
713:         if(disp_refr->render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_PARTIAL) {
714:             /*The area always starts at 0;0*/
715:             lv_area_move(&a, -disp_refr->refreshed_area.x1, -disp_refr->refreshed_area.y1);
716:         }
717: 
718:         lv_draw_buf_clear(layer->draw_buf, &a);
719:     }
720: 
721:     lv_obj_t * top_act_scr = NULL;
722:     lv_obj_t * top_prev_scr = NULL;
723: 
724:     /*Get the most top object which is not covered by others*/
725:     top_act_scr = lv_refr_get_top_obj(&layer->_clip_area, lv_display_get_screen_active(disp_refr));
726:     if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
727:         top_prev_scr = lv_refr_get_top_obj(&layer->_clip_area, disp_refr->prev_scr);
728:     }
729: 
730:     /*Draw a bottom layer background if there is no top object*/
731:     if(top_act_scr == NULL && top_prev_scr == NULL) {
732:         refr_obj_and_children(layer, lv_display_get_layer_bottom(disp_refr));
733:     }
734: 
735:     if(disp_refr->draw_prev_over_act) {
736:         if(top_act_scr == NULL) top_act_scr = disp_refr->act_scr;
737:         refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_act_scr);
738: 
739:         /*Refresh the previous screen if any*/
740:         if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
741:             if(top_prev_scr == NULL) top_prev_scr = disp_refr->prev_scr;
742:             refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_prev_scr);
743:         }
744:     }
745:     else {
746:         /*Refresh the previous screen if any*/
747:         if(disp_refr->prev_scr) {
748:             if(top_prev_scr == NULL) top_prev_scr = disp_refr->prev_scr;
749:             refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_prev_scr);
750:         }
751: 
752:         if(top_act_scr == NULL) top_act_scr = disp_refr->act_scr;
753:         refr_obj_and_children(layer, top_act_scr);
754:     }
755: 
756:     /*Also refresh top and sys layer unconditionally*/
757:     refr_obj_and_children(layer, lv_display_get_layer_top(disp_refr));
758:     refr_obj_and_children(layer, lv_display_get_layer_sys(disp_refr));
759: 
760:     draw_buf_flush(disp_refr);
761:     LV_PROFILER_END;
762: }

764: /**
765:  * Search the most top object which fully covers an area
766:  * @param area_p pointer to an area
767:  * @param obj the first object to start the searching (typically a screen)
768:  * @return
769:  */
770: static lv_obj_t * lv_refr_get_top_obj(const lv_area_t * area_p, lv_obj_t * obj)
771: {
772:     lv_obj_t * found_p = NULL;
773: 
774:     if(lv_area_is_in(area_p, &obj->coords, 0) == false) return NULL;
775:     if(lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN)) return NULL;
776:     if(lv_obj_get_layer_type(obj) != LV_LAYER_TYPE_NONE) return NULL;
777: 
778:     /*If this object is fully cover the draw area then check the children too*/
779:     lv_cover_check_info_t info;
780:     info.res = LV_COVER_RES_COVER;
781:     info.area = area_p;
782:     lv_obj_send_event(obj, LV_EVENT_COVER_CHECK, &info);
783:     if(info.res == LV_COVER_RES_MASKED) return NULL;
784: 
785:     int32_t i;
786:     int32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_count(obj);
787:     for(i = child_cnt - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
788:         lv_obj_t * child = obj->spec_attr->children[i];
789:         found_p = lv_refr_get_top_obj(area_p, child);
790: 
791:         /*If a children is ok then break*/
792:         if(found_p != NULL) {
793:             break;
794:         }
795:     }
796: 
797:     /*If no better children use this object*/
798:     if(found_p == NULL && info.res == LV_COVER_RES_COVER) {
799:         found_p = obj;
800:     }
801: 
802:     return found_p;
803: }
804: 
805: /**
806:  * Make the refreshing from an object. Draw all its children and the youngers too.
807:  * @param top_p pointer to an objects. Start the drawing from it.
808:  * @param mask_p pointer to an area, the objects will be drawn only here
809:  */
810: static void refr_obj_and_children(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * top_obj)
811: {
812:     /*Normally always will be a top_obj (at least the screen)
813:      *but in special cases (e.g. if the screen has alpha) it won't.
814:      *In this case use the screen directly*/
815:     if(top_obj == NULL) top_obj = lv_display_get_screen_active(disp_refr);
816:     if(top_obj == NULL) return;  /*Shouldn't happen*/
817: 
818:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
819:     /*Refresh the top object and its children*/
820:     refr_obj(layer, top_obj);
821: 
822:     /*Draw the 'younger' sibling objects because they can be on top_obj*/
823:     lv_obj_t * parent;
824:     lv_obj_t * border_p = top_obj;
825: 
826:     parent = lv_obj_get_parent(top_obj);
827: 
828:     /*Do until not reach the screen*/
829:     while(parent != NULL) {
830:         bool go = false;
831:         uint32_t i;
832:         uint32_t child_cnt = lv_obj_get_child_count(parent);
833:         for(i = 0; i < child_cnt; i++) {
834:             lv_obj_t * child = parent->spec_attr->children[i];
835:             if(!go) {
836:                 if(child == border_p) go = true;
837:             }
838:             else {
839:                 /*Refresh the objects*/
840:                 refr_obj(layer, child);
841:             }
842:         }
843: 
844:         /*Call the post draw function of the parents of the to object*/
845:         lv_obj_send_event(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_BEGIN, (void *)layer);
846:         lv_obj_send_event(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST, (void *)layer);
847:         lv_obj_send_event(parent, LV_EVENT_DRAW_POST_END, (void *)layer);
848: 
849:         /*The new border will be the last parents,
850:          *so the 'younger' brothers of parent will be refreshed*/
851:         border_p = parent;
852:         /*Go a level deeper*/
853:         parent = lv_obj_get_parent(parent);
854:     }
855:     LV_PROFILER_END;
856: }

858: static lv_result_t layer_get_area(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * obj, lv_layer_type_t layer_type,
859:                                   lv_area_t * layer_area_out, lv_area_t * obj_draw_size_out)
860: {
861:     int32_t ext_draw_size = lv_obj_get_ext_draw_size(obj);
862:     lv_obj_get_coords(obj, obj_draw_size_out);
863:     lv_area_increase(obj_draw_size_out, ext_draw_size, ext_draw_size);
864: 
865:     if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_TRANSFORM) {
866:         /*Get the transformed area and clip it to the current clip area.
867:          *This area needs to be updated on the screen.*/
868:         lv_area_t clip_coords_for_obj;
869:         lv_area_t tranf_coords = *obj_draw_size_out;
870:         lv_obj_get_transformed_area(obj, &tranf_coords, LV_OBJ_POINT_TRANSFORM_FLAG_NONE);
871:         if(!lv_area_intersect(&clip_coords_for_obj, &layer->_clip_area, &tranf_coords)) {
872:             return LV_RESULT_INVALID;
873:         }
874: 
875:         /*Transform back (inverse) the transformed area.
876:          *It will tell which area of the non-transformed widget needs to be redrawn
877:          *in order to cover transformed area after transformation.*/
878:         lv_area_t inverse_clip_coords_for_obj = clip_coords_for_obj;
879:         lv_obj_get_transformed_area(obj, &inverse_clip_coords_for_obj, LV_OBJ_POINT_TRANSFORM_FLAG_INVERSE);
880:         if(!lv_area_intersect(&inverse_clip_coords_for_obj, &inverse_clip_coords_for_obj, obj_draw_size_out)) {
881:             return LV_RESULT_INVALID;
882:         }
883: 
884:         *layer_area_out = inverse_clip_coords_for_obj;
885:         lv_area_increase(layer_area_out, 5, 5); /*To avoid rounding error*/
886:     }
887:     else if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_SIMPLE) {
888:         lv_area_t clip_coords_for_obj;
889:         if(!lv_area_intersect(&clip_coords_for_obj, &layer->_clip_area, obj_draw_size_out)) {
890:             return LV_RESULT_INVALID;
891:         }
892:         *layer_area_out = clip_coords_for_obj;
893:     }
894:     else {
895:         LV_LOG_WARN("Unhandled layer type");
896:         return LV_RESULT_INVALID;
897:     }
898: 
899:     return LV_RESULT_OK;
900: }

902: static bool alpha_test_area_on_obj(lv_obj_t * obj, const lv_area_t * area)
903: {
904:     /*Test for alpha by assuming there is no alpha. If it fails, fall back to rendering with alpha*/
905:     /*If the layer area is not fully on the object, it can't fully cover it*/
906:     if(!lv_area_is_on(area, &obj->coords)) return true;
907: 
908:     lv_cover_check_info_t info;
909:     info.res = LV_COVER_RES_COVER;
910:     info.area = area;
911:     lv_obj_send_event(obj, LV_EVENT_COVER_CHECK, &info);
912:     if(info.res == LV_COVER_RES_COVER) return false;
913:     else return true;
914: }

916: #if LV_DRAW_TRANSFORM_USE_MATRIX
917: 
918: static void refr_obj_matrix(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * obj)
919: {
920:     lv_matrix_t ori_matrix = layer->matrix;
921:     lv_matrix_t obj_matrix;
922:     lv_matrix_identity(&obj_matrix);
923: 
924:     lv_point_t pivot = {
925:         .x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_pivot_x(obj, 0),
926:         .y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_pivot_y(obj, 0)
927:     };
928: 
929:     pivot.x = obj->coords.x1 + lv_pct_to_px(pivot.x, lv_area_get_width(&obj->coords));
930:     pivot.y = obj->coords.y1 + lv_pct_to_px(pivot.y, lv_area_get_height(&obj->coords));
931: 
932:     int32_t rotation = lv_obj_get_style_transform_rotation(obj, 0);
933:     int32_t scale_x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_scale_x(obj, 0);
934:     int32_t scale_y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_scale_y(obj, 0);
935:     int32_t skew_x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_skew_x(obj, 0);
936:     int32_t skew_y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_skew_y(obj, 0);
937: 
938:     if(scale_x <= 0 || scale_y <= 0) {
939:         /* NOT draw if scale is negative or zero */
940:         return;
941:     }
942: 
943:     /* generate the obj matrix */
944:     lv_matrix_translate(&obj_matrix, pivot.x, pivot.y);
945:     if(rotation != 0) {
946:         lv_matrix_rotate(&obj_matrix, rotation * 0.1f);
947:     }
948: 
949:     if(scale_x != LV_SCALE_NONE || scale_y != LV_SCALE_NONE) {
950:         lv_matrix_scale(
951:             &obj_matrix,
952:             (float)scale_x / LV_SCALE_NONE,
953:             (float)scale_y / LV_SCALE_NONE
954:         );
955:     }
956: 
957:     if(skew_x != 0 || skew_y != 0) {
958:         lv_matrix_skew(&obj_matrix, skew_x, skew_y);
959:     }
960: 
961:     lv_matrix_translate(&obj_matrix, -pivot.x, -pivot.y);
962: 
963:     /* apply the obj matrix */
964:     lv_matrix_multiply(&layer->matrix, &obj_matrix);
965: 
966:     /* calculate clip area without transform */
967:     lv_matrix_t matrix_reverse;
968:     lv_matrix_inverse(&matrix_reverse, &obj_matrix);
969: 
970:     lv_area_t clip_area = layer->_clip_area;
971:     lv_area_t clip_area_ori = layer->_clip_area;
972:     clip_area = lv_matrix_transform_area(&matrix_reverse, &clip_area);
973: 
974:     /* increase the clip area by 1 pixel to avoid rounding errors */
975:     if(!lv_matrix_is_identity_or_translation(&obj_matrix)) {
976:         lv_area_increase(&clip_area, 1, 1);
977:     }
978: 
979:     layer->_clip_area = clip_area;
980: 
981:     /* redraw obj */
982:     lv_obj_redraw(layer, obj);
983: 
984:     /* restore original matrix */
985:     layer->matrix = ori_matrix;
986:     /* restore clip area */
987:     layer->_clip_area = clip_area_ori;
988: }

990: static bool refr_check_obj_clip_overflow(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * obj)
991: {
992:     if(lv_obj_get_style_transform_rotation(obj, 0) == 0) {
993:         return false;
994:     }
995: 
996:     /*Truncate the area to the object*/
997:     lv_area_t obj_coords;
998:     int32_t ext_size = lv_obj_get_ext_draw_size(obj);
999:     lv_area_copy(&obj_coords, &obj->coords);
1000:     lv_area_increase(&obj_coords, ext_size, ext_size);
1001: 
1002:     lv_obj_get_transformed_area(obj, &obj_coords, LV_OBJ_POINT_TRANSFORM_FLAG_RECURSIVE);
1003: 
1004:     lv_area_t clip_coords_for_obj;
1005:     if(!lv_area_intersect(&clip_coords_for_obj, &layer->_clip_area, &obj_coords)) {
1006:         return false;
1007:     }
1008: 
1009:     bool has_clip = lv_memcmp(&clip_coords_for_obj, &obj_coords, sizeof(lv_area_t)) != 0;
1010:     return has_clip;
1011: }
1012: 
1013: #endif /* LV_DRAW_TRANSFORM_USE_MATRIX */

1015: static void refr_obj(lv_layer_t * layer, lv_obj_t * obj)
1016: {
1017:     if(lv_obj_has_flag(obj, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN)) return;
1018: 
1019:     lv_opa_t opa = lv_obj_get_style_opa_layered(obj, 0);
1020:     if(opa < LV_OPA_MIN) return;
1021: 
1022: #if LV_DRAW_TRANSFORM_USE_MATRIX
1023:     /*If the layer opa is full then use the matrix transform*/
1024:     if(opa >= LV_OPA_MAX && !refr_check_obj_clip_overflow(layer, obj)) {
1025:         refr_obj_matrix(layer, obj);
1026:         return;
1027:     }
1028: #endif /* LV_DRAW_TRANSFORM_USE_MATRIX */
1029: 
1030:     lv_layer_type_t layer_type = lv_obj_get_layer_type(obj);
1031:     if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_NONE) {
1032:         lv_obj_redraw(layer, obj);
1033:     }
1034:     else {
1035:         lv_area_t layer_area_full;
1036:         lv_area_t obj_draw_size;
1037:         lv_result_t res = layer_get_area(layer, obj, layer_type, &layer_area_full, &obj_draw_size);
1038:         if(res != LV_RESULT_OK) return;
1039: 
1040:         /*Simple layers can be subdivided into smaller layers*/
1041:         uint32_t max_rgb_row_height = lv_area_get_height(&layer_area_full);
1042:         uint32_t max_argb_row_height = lv_area_get_height(&layer_area_full);
1043:         if(layer_type == LV_LAYER_TYPE_SIMPLE) {
1044:             int32_t w = lv_area_get_width(&layer_area_full);
1045:             uint8_t px_size = lv_color_format_get_size(disp_refr->color_format);
1046:             max_rgb_row_height = LV_DRAW_LAYER_SIMPLE_BUF_SIZE / w / px_size;
1047:             max_argb_row_height = LV_DRAW_LAYER_SIMPLE_BUF_SIZE / w / sizeof(lv_color32_t);
1048:         }
1049: 
1050:         lv_area_t layer_area_act;
1051:         layer_area_act.x1 = layer_area_full.x1;
1052:         layer_area_act.x2 = layer_area_full.x2;
1053:         layer_area_act.y1 = layer_area_full.y1;
1054:         layer_area_act.y2 = layer_area_full.y1;
1055: 
1056:         while(layer_area_act.y2 < layer_area_full.y2) {
1057:             /* Test with an RGB layer size (which is larger than the ARGB layer size)
1058:              * If it really doesn't need alpha use it. Else switch to the ARGB size*/
1059:             layer_area_act.y2 = layer_area_act.y1 + max_rgb_row_height - 1;
1060:             if(layer_area_act.y2 > layer_area_full.y2) layer_area_act.y2 = layer_area_full.y2;
1061:             bool area_need_alpha = alpha_test_area_on_obj(obj, &layer_area_act);
1062:             if(area_need_alpha) {
1063:                 layer_area_act.y2 = layer_area_act.y1 + max_argb_row_height - 1;
1064:                 if(layer_area_act.y2 > layer_area_full.y2) layer_area_act.y2 = layer_area_full.y2;
1065:             }
1066: 
1067:             lv_layer_t * new_layer = lv_draw_layer_create(layer,
1068:                                                           area_need_alpha ? LV_COLOR_FORMAT_ARGB8888 : LV_COLOR_FORMAT_NATIVE, &layer_area_act);
1069:             lv_obj_redraw(new_layer, obj);
1070: 
1071:             lv_point_t pivot = {
1072:                 .x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_pivot_x(obj, 0),
1073:                 .y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_pivot_y(obj, 0)
1074:             };
1075: 
1076:             if(LV_COORD_IS_PCT(pivot.x)) {
1077:                 pivot.x = (LV_COORD_GET_PCT(pivot.x) * lv_area_get_width(&obj->coords)) / 100;
1078:             }
1079:             if(LV_COORD_IS_PCT(pivot.y)) {
1080:                 pivot.y = (LV_COORD_GET_PCT(pivot.y) * lv_area_get_height(&obj->coords)) / 100;
1081:             }
1082: 
1083:             lv_draw_image_dsc_t layer_draw_dsc;
1084:             lv_draw_image_dsc_init(&layer_draw_dsc);
1085:             layer_draw_dsc.pivot.x = obj->coords.x1 + pivot.x - new_layer->buf_area.x1;
1086:             layer_draw_dsc.pivot.y = obj->coords.y1 + pivot.y - new_layer->buf_area.y1;
1087: 
1088:             layer_draw_dsc.opa = opa;
1089:             layer_draw_dsc.rotation = lv_obj_get_style_transform_rotation(obj, 0);
1090:             while(layer_draw_dsc.rotation > 3600) layer_draw_dsc.rotation -= 3600;
1091:             while(layer_draw_dsc.rotation < 0) layer_draw_dsc.rotation += 3600;
1092:             layer_draw_dsc.scale_x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_scale_x(obj, 0);
1093:             layer_draw_dsc.scale_y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_scale_y(obj, 0);
1094:             layer_draw_dsc.skew_x = lv_obj_get_style_transform_skew_x(obj, 0);
1095:             layer_draw_dsc.skew_y = lv_obj_get_style_transform_skew_y(obj, 0);
1096:             layer_draw_dsc.blend_mode = lv_obj_get_style_blend_mode(obj, 0);
1097:             layer_draw_dsc.antialias = disp_refr->antialiasing;
1098:             layer_draw_dsc.bitmap_mask_src = lv_obj_get_style_bitmap_mask_src(obj, 0);
1099:             layer_draw_dsc.image_area = obj_draw_size;
1100:             layer_draw_dsc.src = new_layer;
1101: 
1102:             lv_draw_layer(layer, &layer_draw_dsc, &layer_area_act);
1103: 
1104:             layer_area_act.y1 = layer_area_act.y2 + 1;
1105:         }
1106:     }
1107: }

1109: static uint32_t get_max_row(lv_display_t * disp, int32_t area_w, int32_t area_h)
1110: {
1111:     lv_color_format_t cf = disp->color_format;
1112:     uint32_t stride = lv_draw_buf_width_to_stride(area_w, cf);
1113:     uint32_t overhead = LV_COLOR_INDEXED_PALETTE_SIZE(cf) * sizeof(lv_color32_t);
1114: 
1115:     int32_t max_row = (uint32_t)(disp->buf_act->data_size - overhead) / stride;
1116: 
1117:     if(max_row > area_h) max_row = area_h;
1118: 
1119:     /*Round down the lines of draw_buf if rounding is added*/
1120:     lv_area_t tmp;
1121:     tmp.x1 = 0;
1122:     tmp.x2 = 0;
1123:     tmp.y1 = 0;
1124: 
1125:     int32_t h_tmp = max_row;
1126:     do {
1127:         tmp.y2 = h_tmp - 1;
1128:         lv_display_send_event(disp_refr, LV_EVENT_INVALIDATE_AREA, &tmp);
1129: 
1130:         /*If this height fits into `max_row` then fine*/
1131:         if(lv_area_get_height(&tmp) <= max_row) break;
1132: 
1133:         /*Decrement the height of the area until it fits into `max_row` after rounding*/
1134:         h_tmp--;
1135:     } while(h_tmp > 0);
1136: 
1137:     if(h_tmp <= 0) {
1138:         LV_LOG_WARN("Can't set draw_buf height using the round function. (Wrong round_cb or too "
1139:                     "small draw_buf)");
1140:         return 0;
1141:     }
1142:     else {
1143:         max_row = tmp.y2 + 1;
1144:     }
1145: 
1146:     return max_row;
1147: }

1150:  * Flush the content of the draw buffer
1151:  */
1152: static void draw_buf_flush(lv_display_t * disp)
1153: {
1154:     /*Flush the rendered content to the display*/
1155:     lv_layer_t * layer = disp->layer_head;
1156: 
1157:     while(layer->draw_task_head) {
1158:         lv_draw_dispatch_wait_for_request();
1159:         lv_draw_dispatch();
1160:     }
1161: 
1162:     /* In double buffered mode wait until the other buffer is freed
1163:      * and driver is ready to receive the new buffer.
1164:      * If we need to wait here it means that the content of one buffer is being sent to display
1165:      * and other buffer already contains the new rendered image. */
1166:     if(lv_display_is_double_buffered(disp)) {
1167:         wait_for_flushing(disp_refr);
1168:     }
1169: 
1170:     disp->flushing = 1;
1171: 
1172:     if(disp->last_area && disp->last_part) disp->flushing_last = 1;
1173:     else disp->flushing_last = 0;
1174: 
1175:     bool flushing_last = disp->flushing_last;
1176: 
1177:     if(disp->flush_cb) {
1178:         call_flush_cb(disp, &disp->refreshed_area, layer->draw_buf->data);
1179:     }
1180:     /*If there are 2 buffers swap them. With direct mode swap only on the last area*/
1181:     if(lv_display_is_double_buffered(disp) && (disp->render_mode != LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT || flushing_last)) {
1182:         if(disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1) {
1183:             disp->buf_act = disp->buf_2;
1184:         }
1185:         else {
1186:             disp->buf_act = disp->buf_1;
1187:         }
1188:     }
1189: }
1190: 
1191: static void call_flush_cb(lv_display_t * disp, const lv_area_t * area, uint8_t * px_map)
1192: {
1193:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
1194:     LV_TRACE_REFR("Calling flush_cb on (%d;%d)(%d;%d) area with %p image pointer",
1195:                   (int)area->x1, (int)area->y1, (int)area->x2, (int)area->y2, (void *)px_map);
1196: 
1197:     lv_area_t offset_area = {
1198:         .x1 = area->x1 + disp->offset_x,
1199:         .y1 = area->y1 + disp->offset_y,
1200:         .x2 = area->x2 + disp->offset_x,
1201:         .y2 = area->y2 + disp->offset_y
1202:     };
1203: 
1204:     lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_FLUSH_START, &offset_area);
1205: 
1206:     /*For backward compatibility support LV_COLOR_16_SWAP (from v8)*/
1207: #if defined(LV_COLOR_16_SWAP) && LV_COLOR_16_SWAP
1208:     lv_draw_sw_rgb565_swap(px_map, lv_area_get_size(&offset_area));
1209: #endif
1210: 
1211:     disp->flush_cb(disp, &offset_area, px_map);
1212:     lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_FLUSH_FINISH, &offset_area);
1213: 
1214:     LV_PROFILER_END;
1215: }
1216: 
1217: static void wait_for_flushing(lv_display_t * disp)
1218: {
1219:     LV_PROFILER_BEGIN;
1220:     LV_LOG_TRACE("begin");
1221: 
1222:     lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_FLUSH_WAIT_START, NULL);
1223: 
1224:     if(disp->flush_wait_cb) {
1225:         if(disp->flushing) {
1226:             disp->flush_wait_cb(disp);
1227:         }
1228:         disp->flushing = 0;
1229:     }
1230:     else {
1231:         while(disp->flushing);
1232:     }
1233:     disp->flushing_last = 0;
1234: 
1235:     lv_display_send_event(disp, LV_EVENT_FLUSH_WAIT_FINISH, NULL);
1236: 
1237:     LV_LOG_TRACE("end");
1238:     LV_PROFILER_END;
1239: }

416: void lv_display_set_buffers(lv_display_t * disp, void * buf1, void * buf2, uint32_t buf_size,
417:                             lv_display_render_mode_t render_mode)
418: {
419:     LV_ASSERT_MSG(buf1 != NULL, "Null buffer");
420:     lv_color_format_t cf = lv_display_get_color_format(disp);
421:     uint32_t w = lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(disp);
422:     uint32_t h = lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(disp);
423: 
424:     LV_ASSERT_MSG(w != 0 && h != 0, "display resolution is 0");
425: 
426:     /* buf1 or buf2 is not aligned according to LV_DRAW_BUF_ALIGN */
427:     LV_ASSERT_FORMAT_MSG(buf1 == lv_draw_buf_align(buf1, cf), "buf1 is not aligned: %p", buf1);
428:     LV_ASSERT_FORMAT_MSG(buf2 == NULL || buf2 == lv_draw_buf_align(buf2, cf), "buf2 is not aligned: %p", buf2);
429: 
430:     uint32_t stride = lv_draw_buf_width_to_stride(w, cf);
431:     if(render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_PARTIAL) {
432:         /* for partial mode, we calculate the height based on the buf_size and stride */
433:         h = buf_size / stride;
434:         LV_ASSERT_MSG(h != 0, "the buffer is too small");
435:     }
436:     else {
437:         LV_ASSERT_FORMAT_MSG(stride * h <= buf_size, "%s mode requires screen sized buffer(s)",
438:                              render_mode == LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_FULL ? "FULL" : "DIRECT");
439:     }
440: 
441:     lv_draw_buf_init(&disp->_static_buf1, w, h, cf, stride, buf1, buf_size);
442:     lv_draw_buf_init(&disp->_static_buf2, w, h, cf, stride, buf2, buf_size);
443:     lv_display_set_draw_buffers(disp, &disp->_static_buf1, buf2 ? &disp->_static_buf2 : NULL);
444:     lv_display_set_render_mode(disp, render_mode);
445: }

581: void lv_screen_load(struct lv_obj_t * scr)
582: {

584: }
585: 
586: void lv_screen_load_anim(lv_obj_t * new_scr, lv_screen_load_anim_t anim_type, uint32_t time, uint32_t delay,
587:                          bool auto_del)
588: {
589:     lv_display_t * d = lv_obj_get_display(new_scr);
590:     lv_obj_t * act_scr = d->act_scr;
591: 
592:     if(act_scr == new_scr || d->scr_to_load == new_scr) {
593:         return;
594:     }
595: 
596:     /*If another screen load animation is in progress
597:      *make target screen loaded immediately. */
598:     if(d->scr_to_load && act_scr != d->scr_to_load) {
599:         lv_anim_delete(d->scr_to_load, NULL);
600:         lv_obj_set_pos(d->scr_to_load, 0, 0);
601:         lv_obj_remove_local_style_prop(d->scr_to_load, LV_STYLE_OPA, 0);
602: 
603:         d->prev_scr = d->act_scr;
604:         act_scr = d->scr_to_load; /*Active screen changed.*/
605: 
606:         scr_load_internal(d->scr_to_load);
607:     }
608: 
609:     d->scr_to_load = new_scr;
610: 
611:     if(d->prev_scr && d->del_prev) lv_obj_delete(d->prev_scr);
612:     d->prev_scr = NULL;
613: 
614:     d->draw_prev_over_act = is_out_anim(anim_type);
615:     d->del_prev = auto_del;
616: 
617:     /*Be sure there is no other animation on the screens*/
618:     lv_anim_delete(new_scr, NULL);
619:     if(act_scr) lv_anim_delete(act_scr, NULL);
620: 
621:     /*Be sure both screens are in a normal position*/
622:     lv_obj_set_pos(new_scr, 0, 0);
623:     if(act_scr) lv_obj_set_pos(act_scr, 0, 0);
624:     lv_obj_remove_local_style_prop(new_scr, LV_STYLE_OPA, 0);
625:     if(act_scr) lv_obj_remove_local_style_prop(act_scr, LV_STYLE_OPA, 0);
626: 
627:     /*Shortcut for immediate load*/
628:     if(time == 0 && delay == 0) {
629:         scr_load_internal(new_scr);
630:         if(auto_del && act_scr) lv_obj_delete(act_scr);
631:         return;
632:     }
633: 
634:     lv_anim_t a_new;
635:     lv_anim_init(&a_new);
636:     lv_anim_set_var(&a_new, new_scr);
637:     lv_anim_set_start_cb(&a_new, scr_load_anim_start);
638:     lv_anim_set_completed_cb(&a_new, scr_anim_completed);
639:     lv_anim_set_duration(&a_new, time);
640:     lv_anim_set_delay(&a_new, delay);
641: 
642:     lv_anim_t a_old;
643:     lv_anim_init(&a_old);
644:     lv_anim_set_var(&a_old, act_scr);
645:     lv_anim_set_duration(&a_old, time);
646:     lv_anim_set_delay(&a_old, delay);
647: 
648:     switch(anim_type) {
649:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_NONE:
650:             /*Create a dummy animation to apply the delay*/
651:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_x_anim);
652:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, 0, 0);
653:             break;
654:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OVER_LEFT:
655:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_x_anim);
656:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d), 0);
657:             break;
658:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OVER_RIGHT:
659:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_x_anim);
660:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, -lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d), 0);
661:             break;
662:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OVER_TOP:
663:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_y_anim);
664:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d), 0);
665:             break;
666:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OVER_BOTTOM:
667:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_y_anim);
668:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, -lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d), 0);
669:             break;
670:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_LEFT:
671:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_x_anim);
672:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d), 0);
673: 
674:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_x_anim);
675:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, -lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d));
676:             break;
677:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT:
678:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_x_anim);
679:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, -lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d), 0);
680: 
681:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_x_anim);
682:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d));
683:             break;
684:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_TOP:
685:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_y_anim);
686:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d), 0);
687: 
688:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_y_anim);
689:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, -lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d));
690:             break;
691:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_BOTTOM:
692:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, set_y_anim);
693:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, -lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d), 0);
694: 
695:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_y_anim);
696:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d));
697:             break;
698:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_FADE_IN:
699:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_new, opa_scale_anim);
700:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_new, LV_OPA_TRANSP, LV_OPA_COVER);
701:             break;
702:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_FADE_OUT:
703:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, opa_scale_anim);
704:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, LV_OPA_COVER, LV_OPA_TRANSP);
705:             break;
706:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OUT_LEFT:
707:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_x_anim);
708:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, -lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d));
709:             break;
710:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OUT_RIGHT:
711:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_x_anim);
712:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, lv_display_get_horizontal_resolution(d));
713:             break;
714:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OUT_TOP:
715:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_y_anim);
716:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, -lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d));
717:             break;
718:         case LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_OUT_BOTTOM:
719:             lv_anim_set_exec_cb(&a_old, set_y_anim);
720:             lv_anim_set_values(&a_old, 0, lv_display_get_vertical_resolution(d));
721:             break;
722:     }
723: 
724:     if(act_scr) lv_obj_send_event(act_scr, LV_EVENT_SCREEN_UNLOAD_START, NULL);
725: 
726:     lv_anim_start(&a_new);
727:     if(act_scr) lv_anim_start(&a_old);
728: }

769:     for(i = event_cnt - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

780: lv_result_t lv_display_send_event(lv_display_t * disp, lv_event_code_t code, void * param)
781: {
782: 
783:     lv_event_t e;
784:     lv_memzero(&e, sizeof(e));
785:     e.code = code;

20: #define D13X_FB_WIDTH          1024u

22: #define D13X_FB_BPP            16u
23: #define D13X_FB_STRIDE         (D13X_FB_WIDTH * 2u)
24: #define D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE     (D13X_FB_STRIDE * D13X_FB_HEIGHT)
25: #define D13X_FB_BUFFERS        2u
26: #define D13X_FB_TOTAL_SIZE     (D13X_FB_FRAME_SIZE * D13X_FB_BUFFERS)
27: #define D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE   32u
28: #define D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT (64u * 1024u)
29: #define THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN   (1u << 1)
30: 
31: struct d13x_fb_state_s
32: {
33:   bool initialized;
34:   bool power_on;

36:   uint32_t displayed_yoffset;

43: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache(void)
44: {
45:   uint32_t mhcr;
46: 
47:   /* The custom D13x port does not expose NuttX ARCH_DCACHE hooks, while the
48:    * E907 may inherit an enabled write-back cache from the bootloader.  Use
49:    * the vendor's numeric CSR and raw dcache.call encoding so ordinary GCC
50:    * toolchains still make framebuffer writes visible to the DE DMA master.
51:    */
52: 
53:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
54:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) != 0)
55:     {
56:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
57:       __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0010000b" ::: "memory");
58:       __asm__ __volatile__("fence rw, rw" ::: "memory");
59:     }
60: }
61: 
62: static void d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(const void *address, size_t row_bytes,
63:                                      size_t stride, size_t row_count)
64: {
65:   uintptr_t row;
66:   uint32_t mhcr;
67:   size_t index;
68: 
69:   if (row_bytes == 0 || row_count == 0)
70:     {
71:       return;
72:     }
73: 
74:   /* A cache-wide clean is bounded by the cache capacity and is faster than
75:    * issuing tens of thousands of per-line operations for a large redraw.
76:    */
77: 
78:   if (row_bytes * row_count >= D13X_CACHE_RANGE_LIMIT)
79:     {
80:       d13x_fb_clean_cache();
81:       return;
82:     }
83: 
84:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, 0x7c1" : "=r"(mhcr));
85:   if ((mhcr & THEAD_MHCR_DCACHE_EN) == 0)
86:     {
87:       return;
88:     }
89: 
90:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence" ::: "memory");
91:   row = (uintptr_t)address;
92:   for (index = 0; index < row_count; index++)
93:     {
94:       uintptr_t current = row & ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
95:       uintptr_t end = (row + row_bytes + D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u) &
96:                       ~(D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1u);
97: 
98:       while (current < end)
99:         {
100:           register uintptr_t cache_address __asm__("a0") = current;
101: 
102:           /* T-Head dcache.cpa cleans one physical cache line. */
103: 
104:           __asm__ __volatile__(".long 0x0295000b" : "+r"(cache_address) ::
105:                                "memory");
106:           current += D13X_CACHE_LINE_SIZE;
107:         }
108: 
109:       row += stride;
110:     }
111: 
112:   __asm__ __volatile__("fence\n\t"
113:                        "fence.i\n\t"
114:                        ".long 0x01a0000b" ::: "memory");
115: }

194:   d13x_fb_clean_cache_area((const void *)address, width * 2u,
195:                            D13X_FB_STRIDE, height);
196:   g_fb.update_area.x = x;
197:   g_fb.update_area.y = y % D13X_FB_HEIGHT;
198:   g_fb.update_area.w = width;

205: static int d13x_fb_pandisplay(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable,
206:                               struct fb_planeinfo_s *pinfo)
207: {
208:   uintptr_t address;
209: 
210:   (void)vtable;
211: 
212:   if (pinfo == NULL || !g_fb.initialized ||
213:       (pinfo->yoffset != 0 && pinfo->yoffset != D13X_FB_HEIGHT))
214:     {
215:       return -EINVAL;
216:     }
217: 
218:   address = (uintptr_t)g_fb.memory + pinfo->yoffset * D13X_FB_STRIDE;
219: 
220:   /* LVGL uses DIRECT double buffering.  Before drawing a new dirty area it
221:    * copies the previous frame's dirty areas into the back buffer so both
222:    * framebuffers remain identical.  FBIO_UPDATE only describes the current
223:    * dirty area and therefore does not cover those synchronization copies.
224:    * Cleaning just that area can leave stale cache lines in the back buffer,
225:    * which appear as old labels and widgets after the subsequent page flip.
226:    *
227:    * Clean the complete (finite) data cache immediately before publishing the
228:    * buffer.  This makes every LVGL write visible to the DE DMA master.  It is
229:    * also cheaper than walking the entire 1.2 MiB framebuffer line by line.
230:    */
231: 
232:   d13x_fb_clean_cache();
233:   d13x_de_set_framebuffer(address);
234:   g_fb.displayed_yoffset = pinfo->yoffset;
235:   return OK;

238: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
239: static int d13x_fb_waitforvsync(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)
240: {
241:   const struct fb_area_s *area;
242:   uint32_t source_y;
243:   uint32_t dest_y;
244:   uint32_t row;
245:   int ret;
246: 
247:   ret = d13x_de_wait_for_vsync();
248:   if (ret >= 0 && g_fb.update_pending)
249:     {
250:       area = &g_fb.update_area;
251:       source_y = g_fb.displayed_yoffset + area->y;
252:       dest_y = (g_fb.displayed_yoffset == 0 ? D13X_FB_HEIGHT : 0) +
253:                area->y;
254: 
255:       /* Keep both DIRECT framebuffers identical at the frame boundary.
256:        * This makes the next buffer safe even when only a label-sized area
257:        * changed, without paying the cost of a full-screen copy.
258:        */
259: 
260:       for (row = 0; row < area->h; row++)
261:         {
262:           memcpy(g_fb.memory + (dest_y + row) * D13X_FB_STRIDE +
263:                    area->x * 2u,
264:                  g_fb.memory + (source_y + row) * D13X_FB_STRIDE +
265:                    area->x * 2u,
266:                  area->w * 2u);
267:         }
268: 
269:       d13x_fb_clean_cache_area(
270:         g_fb.memory + dest_y * D13X_FB_STRIDE + area->x * 2u,
271:         area->w * 2u, D13X_FB_STRIDE, area->h);
272:       g_fb.update_pending = false;
273:     }
274: 
275:   /* Release the pan entry after the frame boundary.  Also release it on a
276:    * hardware timeout so a missing IRQ cannot permanently stop LVGL refresh.
277:    */
278: 
279:   fb_remove_paninfo(vtable, FB_NO_OVERLAY);
280: 
281:   return ret;
282: }
283: #endif

285: static int d13x_fb_getpower(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable)

291: static int d13x_fb_setpower(struct fb_vtable_s *vtable, int power)
292: {
293:   (void)vtable;
294: 
295:   if (!g_fb.initialized)
296:     {
297:       return -ENODEV;
298:     }
299: 
300:   if (power > 0 && !g_fb.power_on)
301:     {
302:       d13x_lvds_enable();
303:       d13x_de_enable();
304:       d13x_panel_enable();
305:       g_fb.power_on = true;
306:     }
307:   else if (power <= 0 && g_fb.power_on)
308:     {
309:       d13x_panel_disable();
310:       d13x_de_disable();
311:       d13x_lvds_disable();
312:       g_fb.power_on = false;
313:     }
314: 
315:   return OK;
316: }
317: 
318: static struct fb_vtable_s g_fb_vtable =
319: {
320:   .getvideoinfo = d13x_fb_getvideoinfo,
321:   .getplaneinfo = d13x_fb_getplaneinfo,
322: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_UPDATE
323:   .updatearea = d13x_fb_updatearea,
324: #endif
325:   .pandisplay = d13x_fb_pandisplay,
326: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_SYNC
327:   .waitforvsync = d13x_fb_waitforvsync,
328: #endif
329:   .getpower = d13x_fb_getpower,
